title: HR Intern
description:
Job Description – HR \& Admin Intern

**Position:** HR \& Admin Intern  
**Department:** Human Resources \& Administration  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Location:** Greater Noida  
**Duration:** one year  
**Reporting To:** HR Manager / HR Head

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **HR \& Admin Intern** to support our Human Resources and Administration team. This internship will provide practical exposure to HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, documentation, and day\-to\-day administrative activities.

Key Responsibilities

**HR Operations**

* Assist in maintaining and updating employee records and HR documentation.
* Support attendance, leave, and employee database management.
* Assist with onboarding and joining formalities for new employees.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports, trackers, and MIS.
* Support employees with basic HR\-related queries.

**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Assist in sourcing and screening candidates through job portals and other channels.
* Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and interviewers.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Assist with offer, joining, and recruitment documentation.

**Employee Engagement**

* Support HR in organizing employee engagement activities, events, and initiatives.
* Assist in preparing communication and engagement material.
* Collect employee feedback and support HR engagement initiatives.

**Administration**

* Assist with daily office administration and coordination activities.
* Maintain records related to office supplies, vendors, and administrative requirements.
* Support coordination with housekeeping, security, maintenance, and other service providers.
* Assist in organizing meetings, events, and internal activities.
* Perform other administrative tasks as assigned by the HR/Admin team.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed **MBA/PGDM in HR, BBA, or a related field**.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Good attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
* Positive attitude and ability to work effectively in a team.

What You Will Learn

* End\-to\-end HR operations
* Recruitment and interview coordination
* Employee onboarding and documentation
* Attendance and HR MIS
* Employee engagement activities
* Office administration and vendor coordination
* Professional workplace communication

Internship Benefits

* Practical exposure to HR \& Administration functions.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced HR professionals.
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.
* Hands\-on experience with HR processes and workplace practices.
* Potential opportunity for future employment based on performance and business requirements.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is **proactive, responsible, organized, eager to learn, and interested in building a career in Human Resources and Administration.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Training Specialist
description:
**Job Description** **ABOUT THE POSITION**


The Finance Operations Learning \& Capability Senior Specialist owns and continuously improves learning, onboarding and capability\-building experiences across Finance Operations. Based in Pune with a global remit, the role leads new\-hire onboarding and assimilation, professional\-skills learning, early\-career development, regional hub integration, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, competency\-framework activities, My Academy enablement, learning measurement and program governance.


The position partners with Finance leaders, process owners, subject\-matter experts, HR, Talent Acquisition and enabling teams to convert business needs into practical, engaging and scalable solutions. The role combines facilitation, program management, employee experience, digital learning, stakeholder coordination, analytical thinking and disciplined operational execution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. New\-hire onboarding, assimilation and employee experience**

* Own the end\-to\-end Finance Operations onboarding experience, including calendars, communications, facilitator scheduling, learning materials, assessments, feedback and follow\-up actions.
* Deliver and continuously improve organizational orientation, foundational Finance Operations learning and new\-hire assimilation activities.
* Coordinate with SDLs, GPOs, tower leaders, managers, subject\-matter experts, HR and global stakeholders to provide a consistent and relevant experience.
* Act as an accessible point of contact for new hires during onboarding and early assimilation, directing questions and escalating concerns to the appropriate owner.
* Coordinate transportation\-account creation and updates as part of onboarding, working with Transport, Facilities, vendors or administrative teams and maintaining accurate status tracking.
* Maintain onboarding trackers, attendance, completion records, assessment outcomes, stakeholder inputs and participant feedback during Onboarding.
* Develop reusable, blended and self\-paced assets that improve continuity and reduce dependency on individual facilitators.

**2\. Global hub integration, Bogotá Specific**

* Support the integration of the Bogotá hub into the broader Finance Operations learning and competency ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global standards while recognizing local needs.
* Partner with Bogotá leaders, trainers, subject\-matter experts and HR contacts to understand capability priorities, onboarding requirements, stakeholder expectations and cultural or language considerations.
* Coordinate cross\-hub learning calendars, knowledge\-sharing sessions, facilitator support and reusable assets across Pune, Bogotá and other Finance centres.
* Promote consistency in foundational learning, competency expectations and employee experience while allowing appropriate local adaptation.
* Track hub\-integration actions, dependencies, risks and feedback, and provide clear progress updates to Competency and Finance leadership.
* Enable transfer of good practices between hubs and maintain shared documentation so learning solutions can be reused and scaled globally.

**3\. Learning needs analysis and solution design**

* Construct structured discussions with leaders, managers and process owners to identify learning needs, capability gaps and desired business outcomes.
* Design and deliver classroom, virtual, self\-paced, e\-learning and micro\-learning solutions.
* Create/convert existing learning content such as DTP’s into e\-learnings.
* Translate complex Finance, organizational and behavioral concepts into clear and practical learning experiences.
* Create and maintain courses, facilitator guides, participant materials, videos, quizzes, scenarios, simulations, checklists, job aids, playbooks and toolkits.
* Develop rapid learning solutions such as communication templates and quick\-reference guides when the business requires timely support.
* Support Finance transformation, transition and knowledge\-transfer initiatives from a learning and capability perspective.

**4\. Competency framework and extended capability requirements**

* Partner with Finance leaders, process owners and HR to define and maintain relevant competency expectations for Finance Operations roles and career stages.
* Help translate role requirements into clear knowledge, skill and behavioural competency statements that can guide learning, development and career conversations.
* Support competency mapping, gap identification and prioritization across towers, teams, locations and employee segments.
* Connect identified competency gaps to appropriate curriculum, development pathways, learning assets, assessments or manager\-led interventions.
* Maintain competency\-related documentation, learning matrices and supporting resources, ensuring they remain current as roles, processes and technologies evolve.
* Provide data and qualitative insights on recurring capability needs to inform extended Competency priorities and future learning investments.
* Support communication and adoption of the competency framework so employees and managers understand how it can be used for development.

**5\. My Academy and digital learning enablement**

* Use My Academy as a central channel to support the extended learning and competency needs of Finance Operations.
* Coordinate the creation, curation, publication and maintenance of Finance Operations learning content, pathways, curriculum and supporting resources in My Academy.
* Partner with content owners and subject\-matter experts to validate course relevance, accuracy, ownership, review dates and intended learner audiences.
* Maintain content governance, naming conventions, version control and review cycles so learning resources remain current and easy to find.
* Support learner enrolment, assignment, campaign communication, completion follow\-up and reporting in collaboration with the relevant platform or LMS owners.
* Use available platform insights(Workday, Menti\-meter, Canva, MS\-Forms) to understand participation, completion, content usage and learning gaps, and recommend improvements to curriculum and learner journeys.
* Promote awareness and adoption of My Academy through onboarding, learning campaigns, manager communication and self\-directed development guidance.
* Identify opportunities to retire outdated or duplicate materials and improve the overall learner experience.

**6\. AI integration and learning innovation**

* Identify and pilot responsible AI use cases that improve learning design, content creation, knowledge access, communication, reporting and administrative efficiency.
* Use approved AI tools to support first drafts, summaries, quizzes, scenarios, learning aids and content repurposing, with appropriate subject\-matter review before publication.
* Explore AI\-enabled approaches for personalized learning recommendations, recurring\-question analysis, knowledge discovery and identification of content gaps.
* Partner with relevant technology, HR and governance stakeholders to ensure AI use complies with confidentiality, data\-protection, intellectual\-property and responsible\-use requirements.
* Document AI\-enabled workflows, quality checks, limitations and human\-review responsibilities to enable safe and repeatable adoption.
* Share practical AI guidance and good practices with trainers, content owners and the wider Competency community.

**7\. Personal excellence, soft skills and people development**

* Design and facilitate interventions in professional communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, problem solving, workplace effectiveness, business etiquette and personal excellence.
* Manage and publish the relevant learning calendar in partnership with Finance, Delivery, site leadership and HR.
* Facilitate programs for associates, interns, managers and other employee groups based on business priorities.
* Coach internal trainers and subject\-matter experts through facilitator guidance, preparation, observation and feedback.
* Promote a learning culture through practice, reflection, feedback, knowledge sharing and manager involvement.

**8\. Internship and early\-career development**

* Coordinate the development components of Finance Operations internship and early\-career programs from orientation through completion.
* Design and deliver classroom\-to\-corporate transition journeys, personal\-excellence learning, engagement activities, assessments and development checkpoints.
* Coordinate assessments and consolidate results and stakeholder inputs to support deployment and development discussions.
* Partner with managers, HR and Talent Acquisition on team allocation, progress monitoring, learning interventions and conversion\-readiness inputs.
* Maintain regular communication with interns and Intern Champions (Functional Managers), identify development or engagement risks and coordinate appropriate support.
* Ensure final hiring, rating, deployment and conversion decisions remain with authorized business and HR owners.

**9\. Knowledge management, Knowledge Nugget and communications**

* Prepare, curate and publish the recurring Knowledge Nugget, converting Finance, workplace, process or capability insights into concise and engaging communication.
* Coordinate topics and inputs with leaders and process experts, validate content before publication and maintain a forward content calendar and repository.
* Maintain learning manuals, playbooks, templates, knowledge\-transfer documents and reusable resources in accessible locations.
* Create clear communications for onboarding, learning programs, assessments, campaigns and development initiatives.
* Support learning\-related town halls, engagement events, videos, newsletters and wider Finance communications as agreed with stakeholders.
* Build participation through timely communication, purposeful branding and audience\-appropriate messaging.
* Manage the Procurement of Goodies for participants of any competency led engagement initiatives

**10\. Measurement, governance and stakeholder coordination**

* Define and track indicators such as volume, participation, completion, assessment results, feedback, content usage, recurring questions, competency gaps and agreed business measures.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders, highlighting outcomes, trends, risks, dependencies and recommended actions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve content, delivery methods, learner journeys and program processes.
* Maintain accurate records, dashboards, content inventories, standard operating procedures and version control.
* Build trusted partnerships with Finance leaders, SDLs, GPOs, tower managers, Bogotá and other hub stakeholders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Transport, Facilities and platform owners.
* Clarify scope, ownership, timelines and dependencies for each initiative and communicate risks early.
* Coordinate internal contributors, facilitators and external vendors where required and manage competing priorities to agreed timelines.

  

**Qualifications** **CORE CAPABILITIES**


Learning Program Design


Onboarding \& Assimilation


Global Hub Integration


Competency Frameworks


My Academy / LMS Enablement


AI \& Digital Learning


Stakeholder Partnership


KPI Tracking \& Insights


Knowledge Management

**HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED:**

* Consistent, timely onboarding delivery, including accurate communications, completion tracking and transportation\-account coordination.
* Effective integration of Bogotá and other hubs into shared learning standards, resources and governance.
* Current and usable competency maps that connect identified needs to clear development actions.
* Well\-governed, accessible and actively used Finance Operations content and pathways in My Academy.
* Responsible AI pilots that demonstrate practical efficiency or learner\-experience benefits with documented controls.
* Reliable learning calendars, internship activities, Knowledge Nugget publications and stakeholder updates.
* Accurate reporting and evidence\-based improvement across learning, competency and employee\-experience initiatives.
* Reduced key\-person dependency through documented processes, reusable assets, shared ownership and effective handover.

**ROLE OWNERSHIP AND PARTNERSHIP BOUNDARIES:**

 **ROLE OWNS**

* Learning design and facilitation
* Onboarding operations
* Knowledge Nugget
* Learning records and reporting
* My Academy content governance

**COORDINATES / SUPPORTS**

* Bogotá hub integration
* Competency mapping
* AI pilots and adoption
* Transport\-account setup
* Intern assessments and development

**AUTHORIZED OWNER RETAINS**

* Formal HR policy interpretation
* Employee\-relations investigations
* Payroll and benefits
* Final hiring, rating or conversion decisions
* Technical Finance sign\-off

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

**Employee Query Management**

* Maintain high service standards and employee satisfaction.

**Reporting \& MIS**

**Experience**

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop 3–5 designers
* Drive the UX vision and execution of a platform that produces a product line to revolutionize workplace productivity and analytics solutions for some of the largest companies in the world
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product management, user research, engineering and content from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the product roadmaps
* Distill complex problems into clear goals and requirements for the design and research team
* Understand the company's Design Systems, encourage their application, and contribute to their further development and maintenance.
* Drive the growth of user\-centric, collaborative culture across the Business Unit
* Evangelize design strategy and product vision across the global, distributed design teams
* Assist in conducting user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans.
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others.
* Lead your team through rapid iterations of theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state\-transition diagrams to document design decisions.
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification.
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation.
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation.
* Travel up to 20% of the year

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing people and/or leading design teams
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in UX Design and/or Interaction Design field
* Passion to grow and mentor people
* Strong skills in Information Architecture
* A portfolio of work samples representing your work and approach
* Expertise in one or more of the following enterprise product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance \& Legal
* Expert with Sketch, Invision, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem\-solving skills to contribute within a multi\-functional and multi\-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast\-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2\.0/2\.1 AA guidelines is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of web design technologies (HTML, CSS)
* Experience working in an agile or incremental manner
* Experience working with tools such as ServiceNow, Miro, or Abstract

title: Placement & Project Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, organised and result\-oriented **Placement \& Project Coordinator** to manage placement activities, employer coordination, candidate engagement and day\-to\-day project operations.

The person will act as a key coordination point between **companies, candidates, training teams, educational institutions and internal management**, ensuring that placement drives and assigned projects are executed smoothly and within timelines.

Key Responsibilities1\. Placement \& Employer Coordination

* Identify and coordinate with companies for recruitment, internship and placement opportunities.
* Communicate with HR teams and hiring managers regarding job requirements, eligibility criteria, salaries and recruitment processes.
* Coordinate job descriptions, candidate requirements and interview schedules.
* Share suitable candidate profiles with participating companies.
* Maintain and develop relationships with existing and new employer partners.
* Coordinate campus/off\-campus recruitment drives, interviews and selection processes.
* Follow up with companies regarding interview results, selections, offer letters and joining status.

2\. Candidate \& Student Coordination

* Coordinate with candidates regarding job openings, interviews, assessments and joining formalities.
* Maintain candidate databases and placement trackers.
* Conduct candidate briefings and pre\-placement sessions whenever required.
* Ensure candidates are properly informed about company requirements, interview schedules and documentation.
* Track candidate selection, offer and joining status.
* Address routine candidate queries and escalate issues where required.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate assigned projects from initiation to completion.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, task trackers and MIS reports.
* Monitor project milestones, deliverables and pending activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups and maintain action\-point trackers.
* Identify delays, risks or operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly project status reports.

4\. Institutional / College Coordination

* Coordinate with colleges, universities, training institutes and other institutional partners.
* Understand institutional requirements and coordinate placement/recruitment activities accordingly.
* Plan and execute recruitment drives, career sessions, workshops and related activities.
* Coordinate logistics, candidate participation, company schedules and event requirements.
* Maintain professional relationships with placement officers, faculty members and institutional management.

5\. MIS \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate placement and project databases.
* Prepare Excel trackers, MIS reports, dashboards and management updates.
* Maintain records of companies, candidates, interviews, selections, offers and joining status.
* Prepare meeting minutes and follow up on action items.
* Ensure all project and placement documentation is updated and properly maintained.

6\. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Business Development, Recruitment, Training, Operations and Management teams.
* Ensure timely flow of information between internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate multiple activities simultaneously and ensure deadlines are met.
* Support management in preparing presentations, reports and business updates.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint**.
* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
* Good email drafting and professional communication skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently with HR professionals, colleges and senior stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned projects.
* Result\-oriented and proactive approach.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Placement / Career Services
* Recruitment / HR
* EdTech / Training / Education
* Campus Recruitment
* Business Operations
* Project Coordination
* Institutional Relations
* Corporate Relations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new companies onboarded.
* Number of active employer relationships maintained.
* Placement/interview opportunities generated.
* Candidate interview and selection conversion.
* Joining conversion rate.
* Timely execution of recruitment drives and projects.
* Accuracy and timely submission of MIS/reporting.
* Employer and institutional satisfaction.
* Completion of assigned projects within defined timelines.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **strong communicator and excellent coordinator** who can confidently interact with companies, HR teams, colleges, candidates and internal teams. The role requires someone who can take ownership, follow up consistently and ensure that things actually get completed on time.

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, HR Operations
description:
**Job Description** **Who will you be working with?**

The HR Operations Regional Leader is part of the HR Shared Services Team. The role leads an organization of professionals and vendors to deliver regional HR transactional and process support for the employee lifecycle and payroll.


Additionally, the HR Operations Regional Leader leads and delivers enhancements to employee experience through process and system enhancements, transformation, and implementations. The Regional Leader manages team delivery of operational and system support to the Region and works collaboratively with other Centers of Expertise (Talent Acquisition, HRIS, Comp \& Benefits, Legal) to design and deliver HR business processes.

**How will you make a difference?**


As the HR Operations Regional Leader, you will play a key role in shaping an exceptional employee experience by driving efficient, scalable, and compliant HR and payroll operations across the region. Through strong leadership, process optimization, and collaboration with HR Centers of Expertise and business stakeholders, you will enhance service delivery, lead transformative initiatives, and leverage technology to simplify and improve the employee lifecycle. Your ability to balance operational excellence with continuous improvement will help build a high\-performing HR function that supports both business growth and employee success.


In this role you will:

* Lead and manage people and processes essential to the employee lifecycle and payroll for Indonesia, China, Australia, and New Zealand.
* Manage, develop, and engage a high\-performing regional team; build functional and leadership capability within the team and bench\-strength for future needs; deploy resources to fit business needs.
* Develop strategic partnerships with local HR to evaluate and evolve relationship in the region and ensure performance in accordance with SLAs. Lead quarterly service reviews.
* Partner with regional stakeholders to identify regional projects and process improvements; prioritize, plan, scope out projects and work with team to implement.
* Serve as a point of escalation for service issue themes, identifying root cause and path to resolution to ensure continued service improvement.
* Lead team projects regionally and/or globally to evolve HR processes that span across the employee life cycle; drive process improvements and standardization in partnership with Continuous Improvement Team.
* Provide support to cross\-functional workstreams in the region, such as Acquisitions, Reorganizations, Legal Entity Changes.
* Ensure local processes are documented thoroughly and team understands processes fully. Communicate and provide change management to team and HR community when changes are implemented.
* Monitor best practices, industry standards, local requirements; implement changes to internal processes as needed.

* **What We Want to Know About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, Information Systems, or relevant field. Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for education requirements.
* 10\-15 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a Shared Services environment and should have experience managing APAC countries.
* Experience with HR administration, payroll, and systems within a large, complex enterprise, ideally across a range of geographies and businesses.
* Experience identifying areas for continuous improvement
* Strong experience working within HR systems, preferably Workday. Experience with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow.
* 3\+ years of team management and development.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite with intermediate Excel skills (pivot tables \& charts, vlookups).

 **Key Competencies**

  

* Excellent communication skills, with ability to motivate and influence without direct authority.
* Strong customer\-focus; ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders.
* Ability to operate autonomously and make quality decisions within ambiguous situations.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset and enthusiasm for problem\-solving and improving customer experience.
* Ability to create focus for self and team through rigorous prioritization of activities.
* Comfortable presenting to stakeholders, business leaders, and HR community. Able to analyse data, draw business insights, and present to stakeholders in a meaningful way.
* Ability to set direction, align operational priorities with business goals, and drive regional HR service excellence.
* Proven capability to lead, coach, and develop high\-performing teams, build bench strength, and foster employee engagement.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes, payroll operations, compliance requirements, and shared services delivery models.
* Ability to identify inefficiencies, standardize processes, implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading organizational change, system implementations, process transformation, and adoption of new ways of working.
* Act as a key partner to the HR Operations Director in driving regional priorities and operational excellence.
* Ability to build trusted partnerships, collaborate across HR Centers of Excellence and business functions, and influence outcomes at multiple levels.
* Strong capability in managing third\-party providers, monitoring SLAs, conducting service reviews, and ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
* Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, make sound decisions, and effectively resolve escalations.
* Skilled in leading regional and global projects, managing competing priorities, and delivering results within timelines.
* Experience leveraging HR systems such as Workday, ServiceNow, and payroll platforms to improve efficiency, reporting, and employee experience.
* Strong understanding of regional employment, payroll, and data privacy requirements, with a focus on maintaining compliance and mitigating risk.

 **What will your typical day look like?**

* Lead and support the regional HR Operations team, ensuring efficient delivery of employee lifecycle and payroll services across Indonesia, China, Australia, and New Zealand and Global Contingent worker process.
* Partner closely with the HR Operations Director to execute regional priorities, drive operational excellence, and support strategic initiatives.
* Monitor service delivery performance, address escalations, and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, HRIS, Compensation \& Benefits, Legal, and Payroll teams to deliver seamless HR processes and employee experiences.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve HR processes, leveraging technology and best practices to enhance efficiency.
* Lead regional and global projects, including system implementations, business transformations, acquisitions, reorganizations, and process redesign initiatives.
* Oversee relationships with payroll and HR service vendors, conduct service reviews, and drive continuous improvements in service quality and performance.
* Analyze operational metrics and trends to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement, providing recommendations to leadership.
* Ensure HR policies, procedures, and operational documentation are maintained, up to date, and aligned with local regulatory requirements.
* Drive change management activities and communications to support successful adoption of new processes, systems, and ways of working.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

 **Additional Information** **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

title: Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace & PEO
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.


Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.


We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.


This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

description:

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Conduct yourself professionally with clients and internal teams.

**Potential Full\-Time Conversion (Post Internship):**

Subject to **Performance**, selected interns may be considered for **Conversion to a Full\-time Position** at the end of the 6\-month internship.

Urbanhub Innovations is a design\-led digital solutions company based in Kannur, building innovative and scalable web and mobile applications for modern businesses across India, the GCC, the UK, and Canada. With expertise in technologies such as Flutter, React, Next.js, and the MERN stack, we deliver user\-centric products that combine functionality, performance, and seamless user experience. At Urbanhub Innovations, we believe technology is driven by people. Team members work on live client projects with real ownership, gain hands\-on exposure across industries and markets, and continuously sharpen their skills in a fast\-evolving digital environment.

We are committed to creating a positive and growth\-oriented workplace where employees feel valued, empowered, and motivated to contribute their best.

**Role and Responsibilities**  
1\. Functional \& Manual Testing

* Test web applications (React, Next.js, Laravel) and mobile applications (Flutter, Android and iOS) across devices, browsers, and screen sizes
* Perform functional, UI/UX, regression, smoke, and cross\-browser/cross\-device testing before every release
* Verify that delivered features match the approved design (Figma) and the agreed requirements or SRS

* Prepare concise QA status summaries for internal stand\-ups and client updates

4\. Task Tracking \& Follow\-ups

* Maintain project trackers, task boards, and milestone timelines for the projects being tested
* Follow up with designers and developers on pending fixes, blockers, and deadlines
* Keep meeting notes, action items, and decision logs updated and circulated
* Flag scope changes, timeline risks, and dependency issues early to the project lead

5\. Client \& Team Communication

* Communicate clearly and professionally with clients across India and international markets over email, WhatsApp, and calls
* Translate client feedback into precise technical requirements for the team, and technical constraints into plain language for clients
* Work closely with UI/UX designers, developers, and content teams to keep deliverables on schedule

6\. Process \& Continuous Improvement

* Suggest improvements to QA checklists, bug\-tracking workflows, and release processes
* Stay current with testing tools, mobile/web platform updates, and QA best practices
* Contribute to internal documentation, onboarding material, and reusable test templates

* Solid understanding of the software development life cycle and the testing life cycle (STLC)
* Ability to write structured test cases and clear, reproducible bug reports
* Strong attention to detail with the discipline to test thoroughly rather than quickly
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English, with the confidence to speak with clients and lead follow\-ups
* Naturally organised: comfortable maintaining trackers, checklists, and timelines, and chasing pending items without being reminded
* A sense of ownership — takes responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of the projects assigned, not just the tickets
* Ability to handle multiple client projects and shifting priorities simultaneously

**Good to Have**

description:
HR Services Department India, Chennai, India
   

  

 Our Graduate Programme in Chennai, India offers a unique opportunity to begin your professional journey while gaining practical experience in a collaborative and fast\-paced HR environment. If you've just completed your degree and are eager to develop your skills and build a strong foundation for your career, our Graduate Programme is the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

 We offer our graduates rewarding career opportunities within our HR Services team, where they can learn, grow, and contribute to a performance\-driven culture. The Graduate Programme provides graduates with the opportunity to gain exposure to key HR processes and support functions, helping them build a solid understanding of HR operations and shared services.
   

  

 Working alongside experienced professionals, graduates will develop practical skills while taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to day\-to\-day HR operations. Additionally, participants will have access to training programmes covering essential HR processes, business communication, professional etiquette, collaboration, and other core workplace skills.
   

  

 All graduates will be assigned mentors who will guide them throughout their development journey at Glencore. The mentoring programme will help new joiners understand our company culture, develop professionally, and build relationships across the HR Services team.
   

  

**Global HR Hub \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme**
 We are seeking a detail\-orientated, proactive, and highly motivated Graduate to be part of the Global HR Services team in Chennai, India, through the HR Hub which supports key operational processes for multiple Glencore offices worldwide.
   

  

 Global HR \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme is designed to prove your aptitude and test your resilience providing functional support to HR Services and Payroll, with opportunities to rotate between.
   

  

 The HR graduate will work in a shared service centre environment (our HR Hub) and the required attributes include strong organizational skills, a customer\-focused mindset, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, globally matrixed environment and gain exposure to international HR operations and best practice and contribute to impactful employee experiences across the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in or have recently graduated with a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related study is beneficial.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.
   

  

 With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Talent Acquisition | Intern
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.
   

  

 Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 to join our HR team. This is a hands\-on internship ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in recruitment operations — from sourcing candidates to coordinating and managing the entire interview lifecycle. You'll work closely with recruiters and hiring managers, gaining direct exposure to how a fast\-paced tech/retail company hires talent
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Candidate Sourcing \& Screening**
* Source potential candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.), internal databases, and referrals
* Conduct initial resume screening against role requirements shared by hiring managers
* Perform basic telephonic screening to assess candidate fit, availability, and interest
* Maintain and update the candidate pipeline/tracker regularly


**Interview Scheduling \& Coordination**
* Coordinate with candidates and interviewers to schedule interviews (telephonic, virtual, and in\-person)
* Send timely interview confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling communications
* Manage interviewer calendars and resolve scheduling conflicts proactively
* Ensure minimal drop\-off by maintaining consistent candidate follow\-up


**In\-Person Interview Management**
* Welcome and coordinate with candidates visiting the office for interviews
* Ensure interview rooms, panel availability, and required documents are in place
* Collect feedback from interviewers promptly after each round
* Communicate interview outcomes/next steps to candidates in a timely manner


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers (candidate status, feedback, TAT)
* Assist in generating basic hiring reports/dashboards for the TA team
* Support offer rollout coordination and documentation as needed


**Some Specific Requirements**
* Pursuing or recently completed a graduate/postgraduate degree (HR specialization preferred)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills with a candidate\-first, professional approach
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple schedules/priorities simultaneously
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with ATS or job portals is a plus
* Ability to work on\-site full\-time for the internship duration


**What You'll Gain**
* End\-to\-end exposure to the recruitment lifecycle at a fast\-growing company
* Direct mentorship from experienced TA professionals
* Certificate of internship and potential for full\-time conversion based on performance
* Real ownership of tasks from day one — not just observation


**Work Environment**
 We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.
   

  

 Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Production Manager **What we believe in**


At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you Lead a team within a production unit in the execution of processes to transform parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely, cost\-effective manner. Ensure continues and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings and quality and safety


The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite


This role is contributing to the ABB India, Smart Power, Electrification, Business, for Production Operation function for Bangalore Nelamangala Location.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Resource Planning \& Production Execution: Organize and allocate resources efficiently to meet monthly production targets, ensuring capacity planning and adherence to demand plans for on\-time delivery.
* Material, Equipment \& Facility Management: Ensure material availability through regular coordination with planning and buyer teams and identify technical equipment and facility improvements as needed.
* Quality \& Process Improvement: Ensure customer PPM targets and zero\-line stoppages by implementing preventive actions, identifying process deficiencies, and advancing improvement initiatives.
* KPI \& Safety Management: Regularly review KPIs for assigned product lines, ensuring safety compliance and maintaining 6S standards across production areas.
* People Leadership \& Development: Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect team members, ensuring teams are well\-organized, staffed, skilled, and aligned with HR policies.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Experience: 10–15 years of relevant experience in a similar manufacturing role with a focus on planning and operational improvement.
* Qualification: Full\-time Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Production Engineering.
* Ensure effective production planning and scheduling to meet volume requirements per demand plans while managing inventory levels efficiently.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on process optimization and productivity enhancements.
* Implement lean manufacturing practices, line balancing, and 5S concepts to ensure operational excellence on the shop floor.
* Plan and manage resources effectively, covering men, machines, materials, and methods to support smooth production operations.
* Comfortable working in rotational shifts (A, B, C), ensuring support for continuous production and operational flexibility.

**More about us**


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low\-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy\-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy\-to\-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

About Chess Gaja

Chess Gaja is a global online chess academy founded by GrandMaster Priyadharshan Kannappan, serving students across 50\+ countries through a distributed network of chess coaches and business operations employees.

We are looking for an experienced **HR \& People Operations Executive** who can take ownership of our HR operations end\-to\-end.

This is an execution\-oriented role for someone who already has practical experience managing HR processes, payroll and HR technology.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with **Zoho People, Zoho Recruit and Zoho Payroll**, along with basic accounting knowledge and the ability to coordinate routine finance and accounting matters with our auditor.

**This is not a fresher or training position. Prior professional experience is required.**

IMPORTANT — MADURAI LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This position is open ONLY to candidates who currently live in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**

You must be **currently residing in Madurai** and able to regularly work from our Madurai location when required.

The role is **hybrid**, meaning there will be a combination of office\-based and work\-from\-home work depending on business requirements and the nature of the work.

**Candidates currently living outside Madurai should NOT apply.**

We are specifically building this position around a **Madurai\-based team member**, so relocation from another city is not the hiring model for this position.

What You Will Own

You will be responsible for running the company's day\-to\-day **HR and People Operations**, including:

**Recruitment → Onboarding → Employee Records → Attendance \& Leave → Payroll → HR Documentation → Employee Support → HR Reporting → Exits**

You will also handle basic finance/accounting coordination and work with our auditor when required.

1\. HR \& People Operations

* Maintain accurate employee records in **Zoho People**.

* Manage attendance, leave and other employee records.
* Manage probation and confirmation processes.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters and other HR documentation.
* Maintain HR policies and employee documentation.
* Handle employee queries relating to HR processes, attendance, leave and payroll.
* Coordinate employee exits and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and payroll information.
* Identify gaps in HR processes and implement practical improvements.

Zoho People

You should have genuine hands\-on experience with **Zoho People**, including:

* Employee setup and management
* Attendance configuration and management
* Leave policies and workflows
* Employee information management
* HR workflows
* Reports
* Basic system configuration
* Troubleshooting and process improvement

We are looking for someone who can **operate and improve Zoho People**, not simply enter employee information into the system.

2\. Recruitment Operations – Zoho Recruit

You will manage the operational side of recruitment.

Responsibilities include:

* Creating and managing job openings.
* Managing candidate pipelines.
* Maintaining candidate records.
* Coordinating interviews and assessments.
* Managing recruitment stages and workflows.
* Maintaining recruitment data and reports.
* Coordinating with hiring managers.
* Ensuring candidates move efficiently through the recruitment process.
* Maintaining an organized talent database.

3\. Payroll – Zoho Payroll

**This is a critical responsibility of the role.**

You must have prior practical experience using **Zoho Payroll**.

You will be responsible for:

* Preparing and processing monthly payroll.
* Verifying attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Checking salary calculations.
* Managing deductions and other payroll components.
* Reviewing payroll before processing.
* Identifying and resolving discrepancies.
* Maintaining payroll records.
* Preparing payroll\-related reports and documentation.
* Coordinating salary revisions, incentives, bonuses and other payroll inputs.

The person hired should be capable of **independently running the monthly payroll process** after understanding Chess Gaja's internal structure and policies.

4\. Basic Accounts \& Finance Coordination

This is **not a full\-fledged accountant position**.

However, you must have sufficient accounting knowledge to understand basic financial information, perform routine number crunching and coordinate effectively with our auditor.

Responsibilities include:

* Maintaining basic financial records in **Zoho Books**.
* Performing basic reconciliation and checking financial data.
* Organizing invoices, bills and supporting documents.
* Tracking basic receivables and payables information.
* Cross\-checking operational numbers and identifying discrepancies.
* Preparing information and documentation requested by the auditor.
* Coordinating routine queries with our auditor/accounting office.
* Supporting basic GST/TDS\-related documentation and data collection.
* Performing basic calculations and financial checks using Excel/Google Sheets.

You do **not** need to be a qualified accountant or CA.

However, you should be comfortable working with numbers and understanding basic accounting concepts.

5\. HR Reporting \& Administration

* Prepare regular HR reports.
* Maintain accurate employee and payroll databases.
* Track attendance, leave and employee\-related information.
* Maintain recruitment and HR reports.
* Ensure important HR deadlines are not missed.
* Maintain organized digital documentation.
* Support management with HR\-related information and reports.
* Continuously improve recurring HR processes.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced professional who:

* Has prior professional experience in HR / HR Operations / People Operations.
* Has **hands\-on experience with Zoho People**.
* Has **hands\-on experience with Zoho Recruit**.
* Has **hands\-on experience running payroll using Zoho Payroll**.
* Has basic practical knowledge of **Zoho Books**.
* Understands basic accounting principles.
* Is comfortable working with numbers and reconciliations.
* Has strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented.
* Can handle confidential employee and payroll information.
* Communicates clearly and professionally.
* Can coordinate effectively with an external auditor/accounting office.
* Can work independently with limited supervision.
* Takes ownership of completing recurring processes accurately and on time.

Required ExperienceMandatory

* Prior professional HR / HR Operations experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho People**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho Recruit**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho Payroll**.
* Basic accounting knowledge.

* **Currently residing in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**

Preferred

* Experience independently managing HR operations.
* Experience coordinating with auditors, CAs or accounting firms.
* Experience setting up or improving HR systems and workflows.

Technology \& Work Requirements

You must have your own:

* Reliable laptop/computer suitable for daily professional work.
* Smartphone.
* Reliable high\-speed internet connection.
* A suitable work environment for occasional work from home.

You will be expected to be comfortable working with cloud\-based systems and communicating digitally with employees, management and external stakeholders.

Compensation

The exact salary offered will depend on your relevant experience, demonstrated Zoho expertise and overall suitability for the role.

Candidates with stronger hands\-on experience and the ability to independently manage HR, payroll and Zoho systems will be considered toward the higher end of the range.

description:
**Associate — HR, Admin \& Client Success** Telosa · Baner, Pune · On\-site, 5 days/week · Full\-time · 1\+ year experience Reports to: Founder \& CEO

**About Telosa**

Telosa is an AI\-powered customer experience platform for multi\-location brands — reputation, listings, lead capture, AI resolution and marketing in one dashboard. We work with enterprise clients across India, MENA and Southeast Asia. Small team, fast decisions, direct exposure to how a company gets built.

**The role**

This is the founder's support role for everything that keeps the company running — people, office, compliance — plus the coordination behind client renewals and the quality of what leaves Telosa in writing. It suits someone early in their career who is organised, versatile, and wants range rather than a narrow lane. You will learn by sitting close to the founder and being the person things route through.

**What you'll do**

*Human Resources*

* Coordinate hiring: post roles, source through portals and consultants, do first\-level screening calls, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates through offer and joining.
* Run onboarding — documentation, appointment letters, induction, asset handover, first\-week experience — and handle exits with the same care.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data; prepare the monthly payroll input for the founder's review.
* Keep HR policy documents current and be the first point of contact for everyday employee queries.
* Organise team events, the festival and birthday calendar, and review scheduling.

*Administration \& Office*

* Run the Baner office day to day: facilities, housekeeping, IT assets, supplies, vendor coordination and AMC renewals.
* Track statutory and compliance paperwork, registrations, insurance and licence renewals; coordinate with the CA and external consultants.
* Process invoices, reimbursements and petty cash; support finance on collections follow\-up.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and visa paperwork for the team.

*Client Renewals — coordination*

* Maintain the master contract tracker: every client, value, renewal date and notice period, always current.
* Flag renewals 60–90 days ahead and pull together the account's usage and outcome data with the customer success and product teams, so the founder walks in prepared.
* Push renewal documentation through to signature and track receivables against it.
* Raise early warning signs — client gone quiet, delayed payment, dropped usage.

*External Communications*

* Draft and manage correspondence going out under the founder's name: client and partner follow\-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, investor update inputs.
* Manage the founder's calendar and prepare briefing notes ahead of external meetings.
* Own the shared inboxes and coordinate outbound comms with the marketing team.
* Keep decks, proposals and templates versioned and presentable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1\+ year of experience in HR, executive assistance, business operations, client servicing or a similar coordination role. Strong internship experience counts.
* High ownership. Chases things to closure without reminders, keeps confidences, and holds several unrelated threads in a day without dropping any.
* Genuinely strong written English. You will be drafting on behalf of the founder; the writing has to land without correction.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is welcome but not required.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and business email, and quick to pick up new tools.
* Presentable and composed with senior external stakeholders — clients, investors, partners, vendors.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to payroll, statutory compliance or contract administration.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS, startup or agency environment.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founder and visibility into every part of the business — hiring, clients, fundraising, operations. Rare at this stage of a career.
* Real ownership from month one, not a filing job.
* Compensation as per experience.
* Baner, Pune. On\-site, Monday to Friday.

description:
**Role Name: Analyst – Platform Operations**
 At Kapture CX, we are looking for an
 **Analyst – Platform Operations** 
 in our
 **Customer Experience** 
 team.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI\-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight\-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.
   

  

 Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca\-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry\-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
   

  

 Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 We are looking for an Analyst to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of our SaaS platform. Beyond day\-to\-day ticket resolution and incident management, this role will contribute to building dashboards, internal utilities, and automated workflows that reduce toil and drive operational excellence. The ideal candidate bridges development and operations, using technical skills to not just resolve issues, but help identify and eliminate recurring problems.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
**Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**
* You will resolve production incidents and customer\-reported issues end\-to\-end, including triage, resolution, and post\-incident review.
* You will build and maintain observability dashboards (Grafana, centralized logging) that give engineering and product teams real\-time visibility into platform health and failure patterns.
* You will develop internal scripts and utilities to handle bulk or recurring issues at scale — reducing ticket volume and manual effort over time.
* You will support RCA for major incidents, identify systemic root causes, and work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure preventive actions are implemented.
* You will analyze ticket trends and platform telemetry to surface patterns and translate them into actionable inputs for the right team.
* You will validate API behavior across client → gateway → backend chains; clearly distinguish client\-side failures (payload, auth, headers) from server\-side issues (latency, errors, downtime).
* You will support deployment validation and production release monitoring and automate repeatable checks wherever possible.


 This is a
 **Bangalore\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
**Success In This Role Means**
* Reduced MTTR for critical and high\-priority issues.
* SLA adherence for issue response and resolution.
* Volume of recurring tickets eliminated through tooling, automation, or permanent fixes.
* Dashboard adoption — stakeholders actively using operational views built by this role.
* Reduction in manual, repetitive operational tasks over time.


**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* You have 1–3 years of experience in a technical analyst, application support, or platform operations role.
* You have proficiency in observability tooling — Grafana, centralized log management, or equivalent.
* You have strong knowledge of APIs, REST services, and HTTP semantics (status codes, retries, timeouts, throttling).
* You have experience writing scripts or utilities (Python, SQL, or equivalent) to automate analysis or bulk remediation.
* You have hands\-on experience with ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk) and API testing tools (Postman or equivalent).


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You have experience with Observability \& Dashboarding — designing monitoring views that surface the right signal for engineering and business stakeholders.
* You have experience with Utility Development — writing tools that solve operational problems at scale, not just one ticket at a time.
* You have experience with API \& Integration Tracing — tracing end\-to\-end flows and isolating failure ownership across client, gateway, and backend layers.
* You have experience with Pattern Recognition — moving from individual incidents to systemic insight; knowing when a ticket is a symptom, not the cause.
* You have strong Cross\-functional Communication skills — translating technical findings into precise, timestamped artifacts that engineering teams can act on immediately.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have experience working in SaaS platform environments.
* You have exposure to production release monitoring and deployment validation.
* You have experience building operational tooling and automation workflows.
* You have experience identifying recurring issue patterns and driving preventive fixes.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* Opportunity to work on large\-scale SaaS systems.
* Exposure to cross\-functional collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Customer teams.
* Opportunity to build tools and automation that directly influence platform efficiency and reliability.
* Opportunity to solve operational challenges with measurable business impact.


**Does this sound like you?**
 Click the Apply button to let us know!
