title: Stores / Warehouse Operator
description:
To assist in the safe and systematic handling of **raw materials and packing materials**, including receipt, storage, material movement, dispensing, and arrangement of materials in accordance with company SOPs, GMP requirements, and safety procedures.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Receipt of Materials**

* Assist the Store Officer in receiving raw materials and packing materials from suppliers.
* Assist in unloading and shifting materials to the designated receiving/quarantine area.
* Check physical condition of containers/packages for any visible damage, leakage, or tampering.
* Assist in proper identification, labelling, and segregation of received materials.
* Follow applicable SOPs for material receipt and handling.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of receiving and storage areas.

**B. Dispensing of Raw Materials**

* Assist in dispensing raw materials as per approved **Material Requisition/Dispensing Sheet**.
* Ensure the correct material, batch/lot number, quantity, and status are verified before dispensing.
* Handle materials carefully to prevent contamination, mix\-up, spillage, or damage.
* Maintain proper identification and status labels during dispensing.
* Follow GMP, hygiene, safety, and dispensing SOP requirements.
* Assist in cleaning the dispensing area and equipment after completion of dispensing activities.

**C. Material Movement**

* Carry out internal movement of raw materials and packing materials between receiving, quarantine, approved/released, dispensing, and storage areas.
* Operate material\-handling equipment such as **stacker**, where trained and authorized.
* Ensure materials are moved safely without damaging containers or labels.
* Follow defined material movement routes and safety procedures.

**D. Material Arrangement \& Storage**

* Arrange materials systematically in designated locations/racks/pallets.
* Follow **FEFO/FIFO** principles as applicable.
* Maintain segregation of materials based on material status and type.
* Ensure proper stacking and safe storage of materials.
* Assist in maintaining inventory accuracy by ensuring materials are kept in their assigned locations.
* Report damaged, leaking, expired, or improperly stored materials to the Store Officer.

**E. Housekeeping \& GMP Compliance**

* Maintain cleanliness and good housekeeping in all assigned stores areas.
* Follow GMP, safety, hygiene, and company SOP requirements.
* Prevent material mix\-ups, contamination, and cross\-contamination.
* Use appropriate PPE while handling materials.
* Immediately report any abnormality, spillage, damage, or safety hazard to the supervisor.

**F. Documentation \& Other Duties**

* Assist in maintaining required stores records and documentation.
* Support stock verification and physical inventory activities.
* Assist during internal/external audits and inspections as required.
* Perform other stores\-related duties assigned by the Store Officer / Stores In\-Charge.

**3\. Educational Qualification**

**Minimum Qualification:**

* **10th Pass \+ ITI** in a relevant trade, **OR**
* **12th Pass** from a recognized board.

**4\. Experience**

* **Freshers may be considered.**
* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, FMCG, chemical, manufacturing, or warehouse operations will be an advantage.
* Experience in handling raw materials and packing materials is preferred.

**5\. Skills \& Competencies**

* Basic understanding of warehouse/stores operations.
* Ability to read and understand material labels and basic instructions.
* Good physical ability for material handling and movement.
* Basic knowledge of GMP and workplace safety.
* Ability to follow SOPs and instructions accurately.
* Good housekeeping and organizational skills.
* Responsible and disciplined approach to work.
* **Should be able to operate a stacker safely after appropriate training and authorization.**
* Basic documentation and communication skills.

**6\. Safety Requirements**

* Operate the stacker/material\-handling equipment only after required training and authorization.
* Follow all safety precautions while lifting, shifting, and stacking materials.
* Use required PPE during material handling and dispensing activities.
* Do not operate equipment if it is defective or unsafe; immediately report the issue to the supervisor.
* Follow emergency and incident\-reporting procedures.

Adwik Ventures is an India and UAE\-based B2B procurement and global sourcing company helping businesses source industrial products, machinery, raw materials and commercial commodities from reliable suppliers across India and China.

We are expanding our India business and looking for a motivated **Digital Marketing \& B2B Lead Generation Executive** to join our team on a full\-time remote basis.

What We Are Looking ForExperience

**0–2 years of experience**

Required Skills

* Basic to good knowledge of digital marketing.
* Understanding of SEO.
* Understanding of Google Ads.
* LinkedIn marketing and prospecting.
* Email marketing.
* Lead generation.
* Good internet research skills.

* Completed a digital marketing course/certification

* Good knowledge of LinkedIn, SEO, Google Ads and lead generation
* Strong communication skills
* A proactive and sales\-oriented mindset

We are more interested in **your ability, attitude and willingness to learn** than simply your years of experience.

Important

This is **not a social\-media\-posting\-only job**.

Our main objective is:

**Digital Marketing → B2B Leads → RFQs → Sales Opportunities → Business Growth**

* B2B prospect databases

* Email campaigns

About Calcyntra Technologies

**Calcyntra Technologies** is a technology company focused on building innovative digital solutions that help businesses improve their operations, customer experience, and growth.

We work across areas including custom software development, websites and web applications, mobile applications, SaaS solutions, AI, automation, CRM/ERP solutions, and digital transformation.

As part of our product ecosystem, **LayoutLeap** is an ecommerce and autonomous business platform designed to help businesses establish and grow their online presence with modern website, ecommerce, automation, analytics, and business\-management capabilities.

About the Role

Calcyntra Technologies is looking for an energetic, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented **SaaS Growth Manager** to drive the growth of **LayoutLeap**.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify potential customers, generate qualified leads, introduce businesses to LayoutLeap, conduct product demonstrations, build relationships, and convert prospects into paying customers.

The role combines **SaaS sales, customer acquisition, business development, lead generation, partnerships, and revenue growth**.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with businesses, communicating with decision\-makers, selling digital products, networking, and contributing directly to the growth of a technology product.

Partnerships \& Business Development

* Digital marketers
* Ecommerce consultants
* Business consultants
* Technology partners
* Other businesses and professionals who can refer customers

Build long\-term relationships with partners and develop referral opportunities for LayoutLeap.

CRM \& Sales Operations

* Keep CRM information updated.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline.
* Track prospect activity and follow\-ups.
* Prepare proposals and quotations when required.
* Provide regular reports covering leads, opportunities, conversions, and revenue.

Market \& Competitor Research

* Research emerging market trends.
* Identify new customer opportunities.
* Understand customer needs and common business challenges.

Collaboration

* Share customer feedback and objections with internal teams.
* Suggest improvements to the sales and customer\-acquisition process.

* Passionate about SaaS, technology, ecommerce, and business growth.

* Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects.
* Strong in verbal and written communication.
* Proactive in finding new business opportunities.
* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Strong at relationship building and follow\-up.
* Able to explain software products in simple language.
* Comfortable conducting online product demonstrations.
* Interested in learning about SaaS and ecommerce.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of growth activities.
* Willing to experiment with new approaches to customer acquisition.

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, SaaS, digital products, ecommerce, digital marketing, customer acquisition, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in SaaS sales and business growth may also apply.
* Experience with CRM tools is an advantage.
* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach, cold calling, or sales platforms is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of websites, ecommerce, SaaS, or digital marketing is preferred.

Key Performance Areas

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable growth activities, including:

* New customers acquired
* Lead\-to\-customer conversion
* Monthly sales/revenue generated
* Paid subscriptions generated
* Follow\-up consistency
* CRM activity
* Sales pipeline development
* Partnerships developed

* Hands\-on experience in SaaS, ecommerce, sales, and customer acquisition.

* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

During this period, compensation will be based on **performance incentives linked to successful sales and business development results**.

Performance will be evaluated based on mutually agreed targets, including:

* Qualified leads generated

A successful **SaaS Growth Manager** at Calcyntra Technologies will:

At Calcyntra Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of **technology and business growth** while helping businesses adopt modern digital solutions.

title: Product Manager / Product Owner — Ecommerce Automation & SaaS
description:
**Company Description** 
 Healthy18 is an ecommerce enablement company that helps brands, manufacturers, and sellers scale their online business. The organization focuses on providing best\-in\-class warehousing, supply chain, and digital marketing services to improve performance on ecommerce platforms. By combining operational excellence with data\-driven strategies, Healthy18 supports partners in increasing sales, optimizing costs, and enhancing customer experience. Team members join a growing environment that values innovation, collaboration, and practical problem\-solving in the ecommerce space.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Product Manager / Product Owner — Ecommerce Automation \& SaaS is a full\-time, on\-site role based in West Delhi. This role is responsible for defining product vision and roadmap for ecommerce automation and SaaS solutions, translating business needs into clear product requirements and user stories. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with cross\-functional teams (operations, marketing, engineering, and sales), prioritizing the product backlog, and overseeing end\-to\-end implementation of new features and improvements. The role involves analyzing user behavior and product performance data, coordinating with stakeholders to refine requirements, and ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality releases. The Product Manager / Product Owner will also support go\-to\-market activities, gather feedback from users and clients, and continuously optimize the product for scalability and efficiency.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the product vision and roadmap for internal automation tools and customer\-facing ecommerce SaaS products.
* Identify manual, repetitive workflows across the business and scope automation opportunities that save time or reduce error.
* Translate business requirements into a prioritized backlog: user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.
* Run sprint ceremonies (planning, grooming, review) and act as the primary point of contact for the engineering team during execution.
* Work closely with engineering on technical feasibility, architecture tradeoffs, and build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* Define and track success metrics for shipped features (adoption, time saved, error reduction, revenue impact).
* Conduct market and competitor research to inform ecommerce SaaS feature decisions.
* Coordinate with design, sales, and operations to ensure products solve real, validated problems.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a hybrid role, ideally in SaaS, ecommerce, or automation platforms — including defining roadmaps, managing product backlogs, and taking a product from idea to shipped feature.
* Strong skills in requirements gathering, user story writing, and process documentation, with the ability to translate business needs into clear specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Experience running Agile/Scrum ceremonies (planning, grooming, review) and acting as the primary point of contact for an engineering team during execution.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers on technical feasibility, architecture tradeoffs, and build\-vs\-buy decisions, even without a coding background.
* Strong analytical skills — able to interpret data, metrics, and user feedback to define success criteria and make prioritization calls.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to represent both business and user perspective to a technical team and build consensus.
* Proven ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and drive initiatives from concept to launch.
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field; advanced certifications in product management or agile methodologies are a plus.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Delhi NCR; this is an on\-site role in West Delhi.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience in an ecommerce company or building ecommerce\-adjacent tools (inventory, order management, logistics, catalog, payments).
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Notion, Zapier/Make, or low\-code automation platforms.
* Startup or small\-team experience where you owned a product area end\-to\-end.

title: Delivery Manager, SEO & GEO
description:
About Geology
 
 Geology is a marketing lab, not an agency. We build AI agents that do the work agencies still do by hand, and we point them at SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization: getting a brand cited inside ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews, which is where a fast\-growing share of buying research now happens).
 



 Both founders are from IIT Bombay and have built companies before. This is the newest one, the team is small, and whoever joins now will be one of the first few people in it.
   




 About the role
 
 You run delivery for our client accounts: the analysis, the deliverables, the reporting, and the client relationship at working level.
 



 Most of the heavy lifting is done by agents we build and maintain. Your job is to run them well, judge whether what comes out is any good, and turn it into work the client acts on. That judgement is the part no agent does yet, and it is the job.
 



 You will work directly with the founders.
   




 Key responsibilities
 * Own delivery for a few client accounts: what ships, at what standard, and when
* Use our AI agents to produce the client work, across technical audits, content, reporting, AI\-visibility tracking and off\-site execution
* Review what the agents produce, decide what actually matters to the client, and take it the last stretch yourself
* Present the work on client calls, agree next steps, and follow up until they ship
* Keep delivery on track: track what is open, and chase access, approvals and blockers to closure
* Help improve the agents you work with


 What we are looking for
 * 1 to 3 years delivering work to clients or stakeholders and owning the relationship at working level. Agency, consulting or programme management all count, and it does not have to be marketing
* Clear written English, good enough for documents that go to a client
* Comfortable presenting work and taking questions on it live
* Consistent follow\-through. What gets committed to on a call actually happens
* Strong with data: spreadsheets, reading a data set accurately, and checking a number before you present it
* Experience with tools like GitHub and Claude Code, or the ability to work out how. You should be comfortable setting a tool up from its documentation and working out why something is not running, since a good deal of what you will use here does not exist yet


 Good to have
 * SEO or GEO experience. Useful, and genuinely not required: we will teach it
* Having used Claude Code, Cursor or similar agentic tools
* Basic Python or scripting
* Agency experience


 What we offer
 * ₹10,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and skill
* Based in Jaipur, working in the same room as the founders
* Direct work with repeat founders, early in building this company, with no layer in between
* The chance to learn how custom AI agents are actually built and run in production work, rather than reading about it


 How to apply
 
 Send your LinkedIn and a two to three minute video. The video brief is short, and it is worth reading before you record.
 



 Apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8mPZ3YneU37xnLB2\_lj\-An2Vhz\-\_P5BOv6ve3OA9HRuW7kQ/viewform
 



 We look at every submission, and we will reply to you either way about next steps.

title: Head of Projects
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead / Senior Manager – Projects

**Department:** Projects  
**Designation:** Head / Senior Manager – Projects  
**Industry:** Mechanical / Engineering / EPC Projects  
**Reporting To:** Director / Managing Director / Business Head  
**Location:** Head Office / Project Sites

1\. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete lifecycle of mechanical EPC projects from project award through engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning and final handover, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality, safety and customer satisfaction.

The position will provide strategic and operational leadership to project teams and ensure effective coordination between Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Construction, QA/QC, HSE, Finance, HR and client/consultant teams.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take overall responsibility for successful execution of assigned mechanical EPC projects.
* Review project scope, contract conditions, specifications, drawings, BOQ, timelines and deliverables.
* Develop and implement detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Establish project milestones, manpower requirements, resource plans and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedule and take corrective actions for delays.
* Ensure effective mobilisation and deployment of manpower, equipment, materials and other resources.
* Drive timely completion of engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.

B. Project Management \& Control

* Monitor project cost, budget, cash flow, productivity and profitability.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and contractual timelines.
* Review project MIS, DPR/WPR/MPR, progress reports and management dashboards.
* Track planned vs. actual progress, productivity, manpower utilisation and project costs.
* Identify deviations and initiate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal teams and clients.

C. EPC \& Contract Management

* Review and understand EPC contracts, work orders, scope of work, technical specifications and commercial terms.
* Ensure contractual obligations are clearly communicated to the project team.
* Identify variations, additional works, claims and potential commercial risks.
* Coordinate with the commercial/contracts team for submission and recovery of variation claims.
* Manage client/consultant communications relating to scope, schedule, resources, variations and project issues.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for contractual and commercial matters.

D. Engineering \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with Engineering teams for timely release of drawings, technical documents and specifications.
* Review constructability and ensure engineering deliverables are aligned with site requirements.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with clients, consultants and vendors.
* Ensure proper integration between mechanical, piping, structural, electrical and instrumentation activities wherever applicable.
* Support technical resolution of site execution issues.

E. Procurement \& Material Management

* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of project materials.
* Monitor procurement schedules against project requirements.
* Review critical material and equipment procurement status.
* Ensure proper coordination with suppliers, subcontractors and vendors.
* Minimise project delays arising from material shortages and procurement issues.

F. Construction \& Site Management

* Provide leadership to project/site managers and construction teams.
* Ensure efficient execution of fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Monitor manpower productivity and equipment utilisation.
* Drive productivity improvement and minimise idle manpower and equipment costs.
* Ensure proper coordination between various site functions and subcontractors.
* Conduct regular site visits and project performance reviews.

G. Quality \& HSE

* Ensure strict compliance with approved QA/QC procedures, ITPs, inspection requirements and project specifications.
* Ensure adherence to company and client HSE standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
* Review quality and safety performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure project documentation and final handover dossiers are completed as per contractual requirements.

H. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor and develop Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Managers and other project personnel.
* Define responsibilities, targets and KPIs for project teams.
* Assess manpower requirements and coordinate with HR for recruitment and deployment.
* Build a high\-performance project management team.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide guidance for capability development.

I. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Act as the senior point of contact for major project\-related matters.
* Participate in project kick\-off meetings, progress reviews and senior management discussions.
* Resolve escalated project issues in coordination with the client and internal management.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and successful project closure.

J. Project Closure

* Ensure completion of punch points, testing, commissioning and final handover.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test certificates and completion dossiers.
* Ensure commercial closure, reconciliation and final billing are completed.
* Conduct project close\-out reviews and document lessons learned.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within approved schedule.
* Project profitability and cost control.
* Planned vs. actual project progress.
* Manpower productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in project delays and idle manpower costs.
* Material availability and procurement performance.
* Quality performance and reduction in rework.
* Safety performance and accident prevention.
* Timely billing and cash\-flow realisation.
* Variation/claim identification and recovery.
* Client satisfaction.
* Successful project handover and closure.

4\. Qualification

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **PMP / Project Management certification is mandatory or highly preferred.**
* Additional certification in Project Management, Construction Management or Contract Management will be an advantage.

5\. Experience

* **15–20\+ years of relevant experience** in mechanical project execution, preferably in EPC / Engineering / Construction organisations.
* Proven experience in handling **large\-scale mechanical EPC projects** from project initiation to completion.
* Experience in managing multidisciplinary project teams and multiple projects/sites.
* Strong exposure to engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning.
* Experience in project planning, cost control, contracts, client management and commercial coordination.
* Experience in handling project teams, subcontractors, vendors and consultants.

6\. Desired Industry Exposure

Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical / Refinery
* Chemical / Process Plants
* Semiconductor / Advanced Manufacturing
* Power / Utilities
* Piping \& Mechanical EPC
* Industrial Projects
* Structural \& Mechanical Projects
* Fabrication, Erection \& Commissioning

7\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong project planning and execution capability.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Strong knowledge of EPC project methodologies.
* Good understanding of project contracts and commercial aspects.
* Strong cost and schedule management skills.
* Knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project and project management tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Strong client and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet critical project deadlines.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites across India.

8\. Personal Attributes

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Result\-oriented approach.
* Strategic and analytical thinking.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.
* Strong decision\-making capability.
* Ability to lead teams independently.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project issues.
* Customer\-focused mindset.

9\. Role Expectations

The incumbent is expected to function as the **overall project leader**, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, within the approved budget and schedule, in accordance with technical and quality requirements, while maintaining profitability and customer satisfaction.

The position will also contribute to strengthening the organisation's project management systems, standardising project execution practices, improving productivity and developing a strong project management team.

description:
**Company Description**  

Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021, its ornamental gardens, tumbling fountains and stately Indo\-Saracenic architecture describing a love story between India and the West. Set on a 21\-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna, this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.


Just 20 minutes from the airport, Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride, guided by migratory birds. Discover 137 rooms and suites, 10 dining experiences, two pools, wellness rituals, and the timeless care of the Raffles Butler.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Learning \& Development Manager to join our team in Udaipur, India. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster employee growth. Reporting to the Director of People \& Culture, you will collaborate with leadership teams across the organization to create a culture of continuous learning and professional development. This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative and empathetic professional to make a meaningful impact on our workforce's skills, engagement, and career progression.

* Design, develop, and facilitate a variety of training programs including onboarding, leadership development, skills enhancement, and specialized workshops to support organizational goals and employee development
* Execute a comprehensive onboarding experience for new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and strong foundation for success; continuously update and improve onboarding processes based on feedback and organizational needs
* Conduct thorough needs assessments in collaboration with department leaders to identify skill gaps and training requirements; translate findings into actionable learning strategies
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all training activities, participant information, and completion rates; analyze training data and metrics to measure program effectiveness and ROI
* Support the development and coaching of departmental trainers, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all training initiatives throughout the organization
* Oversee the administration of online learning management systems, including course assignments, progress monitoring, and completion tracking for mandatory and elective programs
* Partner with operational leaders to review job task checklists and training tools, ensuring they support effective departmental onboarding and skill development
* Collaborate with regional Learning \& Development counterparts to align strategic direction, share best practices, and maintain consistency across the organization
* Support apprenticeship programs and educational assistance initiatives, fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional growth
* Oversee the performance review program to ensure timely and thorough completion of probationary and annual reviews for all employees
* Contribute to broader People \& Culture operations and organizational initiatives as assigned; demonstrate flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business needs

  

**Qualifications**  

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a leadership role, preferably within the hospitality, service, or corporate environment
* Proven experience in designing and facilitating training programs that drive measurable results and service excellence
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting needs assessments and translating organizational requirements into effective learning solutions
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Publisher, Excel, and Word)
* Proficiency with online learning management systems and training administration platforms
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop data\-driven improvement strategies
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to diverse audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships with colleagues at all organizational levels


\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Previous experience in Learning \& Development, talent management, or human resources functions
* University degree in Hotel/Restaurant Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
* Experience with budget management and financial planning for training programs
* Familiarity with change management practices and organizational development
* Coaching and mentoring experience
* Experience developing and delivering leadership development programs


\*\*Key Competencies:\*\*

* Enthusiastic, positive, and motivational approach to employee development
* Detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and quality
* Innovative and creative mindset with willingness to explore new training methodologies
* Collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams
* Flexible and adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Results\-oriented with a commitment to achieving organizational goals
* Empathetic and supportive in fostering employee growth and engagement
* Inclusive mindset that values diverse perspectives and backgrounds
* Efficient and organized in managing time and resources effectively
* Visionary thinking with the ability to anticipate future organizational learning needs

  

**Additional Information**  

* An opportunity to be with world’s preferred hospitality company
* Captivating and rewarding experience working alongside passionate professionals
* Range of exclusive Heartist Benefits
* Develop your talent through learning programs by Academy Accor.

title: Head HR & Administration
description:
Job Description

The Head – HR \& Administration will be responsible for leading the organisation's **human resources strategy and administrative operations**, ensuring alignment with business goals. This role requires a senior HR professional with strong expertise in **HR operations, compliance, talent management, and administration**, preferably within the real estate or construction sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Human Resources Leadership**
* Design and implement HR strategies aligned with organizational growth plans.
* Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning \& development, and employee engagement.
* Lead manpower planning for projects, site offices, and corporate functions.
* Establish and drive performance appraisal systems and career progression frameworks.
* Act as a strategic HR partner to senior management and department heads.
* **Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning**
* Lead hiring for corporate, site, and project\-based roles.
* Build strong recruitment pipelines for engineering, sales, finance, and support functions.
* Manage external consultants and vendors for staffing needs.
* **Employee Relations \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with all applicable **labour laws** (Factories Act, CLRA, Shops \& Establishment, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).
* Handle employee relations, grievance management, disciplinary actions, and exit processes.
* Maintain HR policies, SOPs, and statutory documentation.
* **Compensation, Payroll \& Benefits**
* Oversee payroll processing, compensation structuring, incentives, and statutory benefits.
* Conduct periodic salary benchmarking and support annual appraisal cycles.
* **Administration \& Facilities**
* Head all administrative functions including office management, facilities, transport, security, and vendor management.
* Ensure smooth functioning of corporate and site offices.
* Manage administrative budgets and optimize operational costs.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in **Human Resources** or equivalent qualification.
* **12–18\+ years** of progressive HR experience, with at least **5 years in a leadership role**.
* Strong exposure to **real estate, construction, or infrastructure sectors** preferred.
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR compliance.
* Proven ability to work closely with promoters and senior leadership.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strategic HR Leadership
* Strong Employee Relations \& Compliance Expertise
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Management
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving skills
* High integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism
* Ability to manage both **HR and administrative operations**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stable and engaged workforce
* Strong compliance and risk management
* Efficient HR processes and administrative systems
* Positive organizational culture supporting business growth

title: Valuation Analyst
description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.
* Prepare detailed and professional valuation reports with photographs and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

The role may involve both office\-based valuation analysis and field inspections. The Valuator may be required to travel to client premises, workshops, dealerships, warehouses, construction sites, auction yards, and industrial facilities.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Fresher \-Experience

Reporting To

Valuation Manager / Head of Valuation

Contact\- 8144303866

Pay: ₹12,500\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bhadrakh, Odisha 756100

description:
**Quality Control Engineer**

**Company:** Kuche7 Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Quality Control (QC)  
**Designation:** Jr. QC Engineer  
**Location:** Bhiwandi, Maharashtra  
**Salary:** 20K \- 25K Per Month  
**Experience:** 0–2 year

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Jr. QC Engineer to join our manufacturing team. The candidate will be responsible for supporting quality inspections, maintaining quality standards, identifying process/product defects, and assisting in continuous improvement activities across the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final quality inspections** of materials and finished products.
* Inspect **sheet metal components, fabricated parts, painted components, and modular furniture/kitchen assemblies** as per quality standards.
* Check product dimensions using measuring instruments such as **Vernier caliper, measuring tape, gauges, etc.**
* Identify and record **defects, deviations, and quality issues** during production.
* Support preparation and maintenance of **inspection reports, check sheets, NCRs, and quality records**.
* Coordinate with **Production, R\&D, PPC, Paint, and Assembly teams** to resolve quality issues.
* Assist in **root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)**.
* Monitor compliance with approved **drawings, specifications, BOM/MBOM, and quality standards**.
* Conduct regular **process audits and product inspections** on the shop floor.
* Support implementation of **5S, quality improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives**.
* Maintain proper documentation of inspection results and quality\-related data.
* Assist senior QC team members in **customer complaint analysis and corrective actions**.

**Required Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** – Fresher preferred.
* Basic knowledge of **manufacturing processes and quality control concepts**.
* Basic understanding of **engineering drawings and dimensions**.
* Knowledge of **Vernier caliper and basic measuring instruments**.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Office**.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work on the **manufacturing shop floor**.
* **Ready to work at Bhiwandi location.**

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of **sheet metal manufacturing, fabrication, bending, laser cutting, painting, and assembly** will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of **7 QC Tools, 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and CAPA**.
* Knowledge of **ISO 9001:2015** will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Quality consciousness
* Attention to detail
* Problem\-solving ability
* Analytical thinking
* Teamwork
* Willingness to learn
* Discipline and accountability

**What We Offer**

* Practical exposure to **end\-to\-end manufacturing and quality processes**
* On\-the\-job training and mentoring
* Opportunity to develop expertise in **manufacturing quality control**

Career growth opportunities within the organization

· **Address: Atlanta Industrial Park, Sonale Village, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421311\.**

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer

**Company:** Cryoflame Technologies LLP  
**Location:** Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹10,000 – ₹22,000 per Month

About Cryoflame Technologies

Cryoflame Technologies is a growing IT solutions company specializing in **web development, software development, mobile application development, digital marketing, UI/UX design, and creative media services**. We work on diverse client projects and are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our development team.

Job Overview

We are looking for a motivated and experienced **Full Stack Developer with 1–2 years of professional experience** to develop, maintain, and enhance web applications and software solutions.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with **Python, Django, PHP, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and REST APIs**. The candidate should be comfortable working across both frontend and backend technologies and should be able to understand project requirements and convert them into reliable, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications.
* Build backend applications and RESTful APIs using **Python/Django and PHP/Laravel**.
* Develop responsive and interactive frontend interfaces using **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js**.
* Design, develop, and manage databases using **MySQL and PostgreSQL**.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third\-party services.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs for web and mobile applications.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-structured code.
* Debug and troubleshoot application issues across frontend and backend.
* Optimize application performance, database queries, and API responses.
* Work with UI/UX designers to convert designs into functional web interfaces.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, designers, and project managers.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Use Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Test applications and fix bugs before deployment.

* Stay updated with modern web development technologies and best practices.

**Important:** This position is for candidates with hands\-on experience in **Python/Django and/or PHP/Laravel** along with frontend technologies.

Candidates with strong practical experience and a good portfolio will also be considered.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Description – Business Analyst (Fresher)

**Company:** App Innovation Technologies  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month

About the Role

App Innovation Technologies is looking for a motivated and analytical **Business Analyst – Fresher** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and communication skills, an interest in understanding business processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into clear and actionable requirements for technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand and analyze **business requirements, processes, and workflows**.
* Gather requirements from clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
* Prepare and maintain **Business Requirement Documents (BRD)** and **Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)**.
* Convert business requirements into clear **functional requirements and user stories**.
* Create **process flows, workflow diagrams, use cases, and basic wireframes** when required.
* Work closely with **developers, QA/testing teams, project managers, and stakeholders**.
* Identify business problems, gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Assist in **requirement analysis, documentation, validation, and change management**.
* Participate in client discussions, requirement\-gathering meetings, and project meetings.
* Support the QA team by reviewing **test scenarios and test cases** against business requirements.
* Perform basic **data analysis and reporting** using Excel or similar tools.
* Track requirements and ensure proper communication between business and technical teams.
* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Support **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** and assist in resolving requirement\-related issues.

Required Skills

* Strong **analytical and problem\-solving skills**.
* Good understanding of **Business Analysis concepts and SDLC**.
* Knowledge of **Requirement Gathering \& Requirement Analysis**.
* Understanding of **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, and Acceptance Criteria**.
* Basic knowledge of **Agile/Scrum methodology**.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel** – formulas, sorting, filtering, Pivot Tables, and basic data analysis.
* Basic understanding of **SQL and databases** is an advantage.
* Familiarity with **JIRA, Confluence, Trello, or similar project management tools** is an advantage.
* Good **documentation and presentation skills**.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in **Business Analytics, Finance, Marketing, Operations, or related fields** will be an added advantage.
* Fresh graduates with relevant academic projects, internships, or certifications are encouraged to apply.

Preferred Keywords

**Business Analyst, Business Analysis, Requirement Gathering, Requirement Analysis, Business Requirements, Functional Requirements, BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, Process Mapping, Workflow, Gap Analysis, SDLC, Agile, Scrum, UAT, Stakeholder Management, Documentation, Data Analysis, MS Excel, SQL, JIRA, Confluence, Project Management, Problem Solving, Analytical Skills, Communication Skills.**

What We’re Looking For

* A proactive and curious **fresher** with a strong interest in Business Analysis.
* Ability to understand business problems and think from a **user/business perspective**.
* Willingness to work with cross\-functional teams and learn new technologies.
* Good logical thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
* Candidates who are eager to build a long\-term career in **Business Analysis / IT Consulting / Product Management**.

How to Apply

title: Diploma Electrical Engineer
description:
Job Description Diploma Electrical Engineer

**Position:** Diploma Electrical Engineer  
**Industry:** Manufacturing  
**Department:** Electrical / Maintenance  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Diploma Electrical Engineer** to support electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, and smooth operation of plant machinery and electrical systems. The candidate will be responsible for preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and ensuring electrical safety and equipment reliability.

Key Responsibilities

* Carry out **preventive and breakdown maintenance** of electrical equipment and machinery.
* Troubleshoot electrical faults in production machines, panels, motors, drives, and control systems.
* Maintain and monitor **HT/LT panels, MCC panels, PCC panels, transformers, DG sets, motors, and electrical distribution systems**.
* Handle **PLC, VFD, sensors, contactors, relays, and control circuits** troubleshooting.
* Ensure timely maintenance of electrical equipment to minimize machine downtime.
* Conduct routine inspection of electrical installations and identify potential failures.
* Maintain electrical maintenance records, checklists, and breakdown reports.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for machine maintenance and improvements.
* Ensure compliance with **electrical safety procedures, PPE requirements, and statutory standards**.
* Support installation, commissioning, and modification of electrical equipment and machinery.
* Maintain adequate electrical spare parts and coordinate with stores/purchase when required.
* Participate in **root cause analysis (RCA)** and implement corrective/preventive actions.

Qualification

* **Diploma in Electrical Engineering** from a recognized institute.
* ITI Electrical candidates with relevant manufacturing experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **2–5 years** of relevant experience in **Electrical Maintenance / Manufacturing Industry**.
* Experience with industrial machinery and electrical maintenance will be preferred.

Required Skills

* Electrical troubleshooting \& maintenance
* Preventive \& breakdown maintenance
* Motors, panels \& control circuits
* PLC \& VFD basics
* HT/LT electrical systems
* Industrial safety
* Root Cause Analysis
* Maintenance documentation

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Willing to work in **shifts**, if required.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong focus on safety, machine availability, and preventive maintenance.

JOB DESCRIPTION \- PERFORMANCE MARKETING EXECUTIVE

Position \- Performance Marketing Executive

Experience \-6 Months to 1 Year

Location

Kolkata

CTC

18,000/month \| Higher compensation may be considered for exceptional candidates

Role Overview

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Executive who is proactive, analytical, and capable of thinking independently. The ideal candidate should not be purely task\-oriented but should understand the overall objective of a client/campaign, identify what needs to done, and take ownership of execution.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute and monitor performance marketing campaigns across relevant digital platforms.

Support social media and digital marketing activities to achieve client/business objectives.

Analyse campaign performance, identify trends and improvement areas.

Understand the client's overall business/story and translate it into actionable marketing strategies.

Take initiative in identifying opportunities rather than waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.

Track key performance metrics and prepare basic performance reports.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.

Continuously experiment, learn and optimise campaigns for better results.

What We Are Looking For

6 months\-1 year of relevant experience in Performance Marketing/Digital Marketing/Social Media Marketing.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.

Ability to think independently and take ownership.

Good understanding of social media and digital marketing fundamentals.

Ability to understand the "why" behind a campaign, not just execute assigned tasks.

Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and experiment.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred

Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period.

Candidates with hands\-on exposure to digital/performance marketing campaigns.

Freshers with strong practical exposure/projects and the right mindset may also be considered.

Key Requirement

We are looking for someone who can think, analyse, take initiative and execute independently\-not someone who needs to be instructed for every task.

title: GeM Executive

title: Inside Sales Executive – Intern / Fresher
description:
**About SYSGENIK**

SYSGENIK is a technology consulting and solutions company providing services across CRM, cloud, AI, automation, software development, and digital transformation.

Our technology focus includes Salesforce, Zoho, AI\-enabled solutions, business automation, system integration, and custom application development.

We are hiring an **Inside Sales Executive – Intern / Fresher** to support our business development team with outbound prospecting, lead generation, lead qualification, and meeting generation.

This role is suitable for candidates who want to build a career in **B2B technology sales**.

Previous IT sales experience is not mandatory. Training will be provided on our services, sales processes, prospecting methods, and tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research potential customers and target companies across different industries.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers and business contacts within prospective organizations.

* Introduce SYSGENIK and its technology services to prospective customers.
* Generate new business leads through structured outbound activities.
* Conduct initial conversations with prospects to understand their business requirements.
* Ask relevant qualification questions to identify potential sales opportunities.
* Understand the prospect's current systems, business challenges, requirements, and timelines.
* Qualify leads based on defined sales criteria.
* Schedule discovery and sales meetings with qualified prospects.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospective customers.
* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects and follow\-up activities.
* Update prospect details, communication history, lead status, and activities in the CRM.
* Research companies before meetings and prepare relevant account information.
* Coordinate with senior sales and technical team members when detailed technical discussions are required.
* Achieve assigned outreach, lead\-generation, qualification, and meeting\-booking targets.
* Participate in regular sales training, coaching, and team meetings.
* Continuously develop knowledge of SYSGENIK's services and technology solutions.

**Required Skills**

* Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
* Confidence speaking with prospective customers over the phone.
* Comfortable with outbound calling and cold outreach.
* Good listening and questioning skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally through email and LinkedIn.
* Basic understanding of sales, lead generation, or business development.
* Ability to research companies and identify relevant decision\-makers.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate prospect and CRM records.
* Comfortable working with sales targets and measurable activities.
* Ability to learn new technology concepts and business solutions.
* Self\-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote environment.

**Technical / Tool Skills**

Basic familiarity with any of the following is beneficial but not mandatory:

* CRM systems
* Salesforce
* Zoho CRM
* LinkedIn
* Microsoft Office
* Google Workspace
* Lead generation or prospecting platforms
* Sales intelligence tools

Training will be provided for the tools and processes used by SYSGENIK.

**Educational Qualification**

Fresh graduates and final\-year students may apply.

Preferred qualifications include:

* BBA
* B.Com
* MBA
* BCA
* B.Tech / BE
* B.Sc.
* Marketing
* Business Administration
* Sales
* Information Technology
* Computer Science

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they have strong communication skills and an interest in B2B technology sales.

**Who Can Apply**

This opportunity is suitable for:

* Fresh graduates
* Final\-year students
* Candidates looking for an internship
* Candidates starting their career in sales
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in inside sales, business development, lead generation, telecalling, customer service, or a related role

Experience with IT services, Salesforce, Zoho, SaaS, CRM, cloud, or software sales is an advantage but is **not required**.

**What You Will Learn**

You will gain practical exposure to:

* B2B technology sales
* Inside sales
* Lead generation
* Cold calling
* Email outreach
* LinkedIn prospecting
* Account research
* Lead qualification
* CRM management
* Sales pipeline management
* Discovery meeting preparation
* Salesforce and Zoho services
* AI and automation solutions
* Cloud and software development services
* Professional communication with international prospects

**Work Requirements**

* Reliable internet connection.
* Quiet and professional environment for calls and online meetings.
* Ability to attend online training and team meetings.
* Willingness to make outbound calls as part of the regular role.
* Ability to work according to the assigned business schedule.

Depending on the market being targeted, the role may require reasonable alignment with international business hours.

**Career Growth**

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance and sales capability may progress into roles such as:

* Inside Sales Representative
* Business Development Representative
* Business Development Executive
* Senior Business Development Executive
* Account Executive
* Sales Executive

Career progression will depend on performance, demonstrated capability, and business requirements.

Sales / Business Development: Fresher to 1 year

Remote – India

**Position Overview :** The **Business Process Manager** will act as a key leader responsible for overseeing, evaluating, and improving end\-to\-end business workflows to enhance operational efficiency. In this role, you will analyze existing processes, map complex workflows, identify optimization and automation opportunities, and implement robust process management strategies across various departments.

* **Project \& Change Management:** Drive change management for existing processes using structured change control frameworks, ensuring minimal business disruption.
* **Quality Assurance \& Governance:** Establish performance metrics and ensure all developments maintain high\-quality operational standards and turnaround times (TAT).
* **Data\-Driven Insights:** Utilize strong analytical skills to problem\-solve, generate weekly/monthly productivity reports, and present data\-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field (Master's degree/MBA is a distinct advantage).

* **Technical Skills:** Familiarity with Excel
* **Core Competencies:** Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills. Excellent leadership and communication skills to direct cross\-functional teams.

title: Robotics Trainer
description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Teaching

* Conduct Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, IoT, and STEM classes for students.
* Deliver engaging practical sessions using robotics kits, microcontrollers, and sensors.
* Explain technical concepts in a student\-friendly manner.
* Develop lesson plans and training materials aligned with school requirements.

Project Development

* Guide students in building robotics and STEM projects.
* Mentor students for science exhibitions, competitions, and innovation challenges.
* Support students in project design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Encourage creativity, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

STEM Lab Management

* Maintain robotics kits, tools, components, and laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper inventory management of STEM lab materials.
* Report damaged or missing equipment and coordinate replacements.
* Maintain safety standards within the laboratory.

Technical Support

* Assist students in coding using Arduino, Scratch, Python, and other relevant platforms.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues during training sessions.
* Support installation and configuration of robotics hardware and software.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain attendance and training records.
* Prepare progress reports for students and schools.
* Document student projects and achievements.
* Capture photos and videos of activities for reporting and promotional purposes.

Competition \& Event Coordination

* Train students for robotics competitions and hackathons.
* Organize STEM workshops, innovation camps, and demonstrations.
* Support school\-level and inter\-school robotics events.

Continuous Learning

* Stay updated with emerging technologies in Robotics, AI, IoT, and STEM education.
* Participate in internal training and skill development programs.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Physics (B.Sc.), Mathematics (B.Sc.), Electronics (B.Sc.), or any other relevant STEM discipline.
* Freshers with strong technical skills are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or training experience is an added advantage.

Required Technical Skills

* Arduino Programming
* Electronics and Circuit Design
* Robotics Systems
* Embedded Systems
* Python Programming (Basic to Intermediate)
* IoT Concepts
* Sensor and Actuator Integration
* Basic AI and Machine Learning Concepts
* Troubleshooting and Debugging

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle school students of different age groups.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities.
* Passion for teaching and technology.
* Good teamwork and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in STEM education.
* Participation in robotics competitions or technical projects.
* Knowledge of 3D Printing, CAD Design, Drones, or AI applications.
* Certification in Robotics, Embedded Systems, or STEM Training.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Tool Room Operations \& Profit Centre Management

· New Tool Manufacturing

· Tool Maintenance

· Coordination with Design \& Development

· Tool Manufacturing Cost Control

· Consumable Cost Control

· Machine \& Equipment Management

· Systems, Discipline \& Process Improvement

· Manpower Management

· Productivity \& Continuous Improvement

· Management Review \& MIS

· Team Leadership \& Development

**Required Technical \& Managerial Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Press Tool Design \& Manufacturing**
* Tool Maintenance \& Troubleshooting
* Tool Manufacturing Planning
* Machining \& Tool Room Processes
* VMC / CNC / Wire Cut / EDM / Grinding
* Tool Costing and Cost Control
* Make\-or\-Buy Analysis
* Machine Utilization \& Capacity Planning
* Manpower Planning
* Production Planning \& Monitoring
* Preventive Maintenance
* Root Cause Analysis \& Problem Solving

* Team Leadership and People Management
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Good communication and presentation skills

* **Ownership\-oriented approach**
* Strong commercial and cost consciousness
* Data\-driven decision making
* Ability to take quick and practical decisions
* Strong shop\-floor presence
* Planning and execution capability
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Team\-building and leadership skills
* Ability to establish systems and discipline
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to manage pressure and delivery commitments

**People \+ Machines \+ Cost \+ Quality \+ Delivery \+ Maintenance \+ Productivity \+ Profitability**

**To establish and operate a high\-productivity, cost\-effective and profitable Tool Room capable of delivering high\-quality new press tools on time while ensuring reliable maintenance and maximum availability of production tools.**

title: Human Resources Assistant Intern
description:
**Location** 
 : Noida (On\-site)
 



**Company** 
 : Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Duration** 
 : 2–6 months (flexible, based on your academic commitments)
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Internship
 



  





**About Zynence** 




 Zynence is building an AI\-native, full\-lifecycle hardware engineering platform. A connected workspace that takes a hardware product from requirements and system architecture through BOM/cost, firmware, schematic/PCB, simulation, validation, and manufacturing. We're a small, early\-stage team growing quickly, which means the person in this role won't be handling a narrow slice of HR, you'll help build the HR function itself, alongside the founders.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for an HR Intern to plan and execute recruitment, onboarding, and day\-to\-day HR coordination as we grow the team. You'll own real parts of the hiring pipeline, not just admin support for someone else's process, from sourcing and screening candidates through to getting new hires set up and settled in. This is a hands\-on role at a startup where things are still being figured out: you'll help build the processes as much as run them.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 


* Draft and post job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri, and other relevant platforms.
* Source and screen candidates for open roles, using both inbound applications and proactive outreach.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and the hiring team.
* Maintain a candidate pipeline tracker and keep applicants informed at each stage of the process.
* Support salary/offer discussions and documentation in coordination with the founders.



 Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle
 


* Plan and run onboarding for new hires — documentation, systems access, introductions, and first\-week schedules.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation (offer letters, contracts, ID/verification paperwork).
* Act as a point of contact for new joiners during their first few weeks.
* Support offboarding processes when needed, ensuring a clean handover and exit documentation.



 HR Coordination \& Operations
 


* Maintain HR trackers — headcount, open positions, interview pipelines, onboarding status.
* Help coordinate internal communication, team announcements, and basic HR policies.
* Support attendance, leave tracking, and other day\-to\-day HR administration.
* Assist with organizing team events, check\-ins, or culture\-building activities as the team grows.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Required
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills \- you'll be the first point of contact for many candidates and new hires.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) for tracking pipelines, records, and schedules.
* Organized and detail\-oriented \- able to juggle multiple candidates, timelines, and documents without letting things slip.
* Trustworthy with confidential information \- HR work involves sensitive personal and compensation data.



 Preferred
 


* Prior internship or hands\-on experience in HR, recruitment, or people operations.
* Familiarity with recruitment platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre, or similar) and applicant tracking approaches.
* Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to speed up screening, scheduling, and documentation work \- we use AI heavily across the company and like people who do too.
* Genuine interest in startup environments and building processes from scratch rather than following an existing playbook.



  





**What We Look For** 



* Ownership \- you follow a candidate or a new hire through to the end, not just to the next step in your task list.
* Judgment and discretion \- you handle sensitive information (compensation, personal details, performance conversations) with care.
* People\-oriented \- you enjoy talking to candidates and helping new hires feel welcome, not just processing paperwork.
* Comfort with ambiguity \- this is an early\-stage company; processes will be incomplete and priorities will shift.
* Clear communication \- with candidates, new hires, and founders alike.



  





**Duration \& Logistics** 




 This is a 2–6 month internship; the exact duration is flexible and can be structured around your academic schedule (semester breaks, part\-time alongside coursework, or a dedicated full\-time block). On\-site at our Noida office.
 



  





**Why Join Zynence?** 



* Build the HR function at an early\-stage company from the ground up — your work will shape how we hire and onboard people, not just execute someone else's process.
* Direct exposure to founders and hiring decisions, not a narrow HR\-admin role buried in a large company.
* Real ownership over recruitment and onboarding for a live, growing team — not a shadow/observation internship.
* Broad exposure to how an early\-stage tech startup actually operates, beyond HR alone.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to sushil@zynence.com
 



 Subject: Application for HR Intern – Zynence
 



 Please mention your availability (start date, and how many months you can commit to) in your application.
