title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Job Title**

**Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive**

**Company**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)**

**Location**

Baner, Pune, Work from Office

**Employment Type**

Full\-time

**Experience**

1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar role

**Compensation**

₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA (Based on experience and expertise)

**Education**

Graduate (B.Tech, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.), MBA preferred

**About House of EdTech**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)** is a high\-growth, multi\-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering **large\-scale, outcome\-driven professional education** across high\-impact domains including **Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills**.

Founded by **Aditya Goenka \- Founder @ Be10x \& Office Master \| Enabling People Upskill Themselves \| LinkedIn)** and **Aditya Kachave \- Be10x \| LinkedIn),** **IIT Kharagpur alumni**, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India’s most dynamic EdTech groups by combining **cutting\-edge curriculum, practitioner\-led training, and performance\-driven execution**. With a strong learner\-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to **upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth**.

Today, the organization:

* **Serves over 5 million learners** across India and global markets
* Operates at an **annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeding ₹450 crore**
* Employs **2,000\+ professionals** across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations
* Maintains a **strong on\-ground presence in Pune and Kolkata**, supported by pan\-India digital reach

**Diversified Brand Portfolio**

House of EdTech operates a **strategically diversified portfolio of category\-leading education brands**, each addressing distinct learner needs and professional outcomes:

* **Be10x** ()Focused on practical AI tools and productivity solutions that help professionals work smarter and faster using real\-world AI applications.
* **Office Master** ()Specializes in advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs designed for business and data professionals.
* **AI for Techies** ()Caters to technical professionals seeking hands\-on AI, Python, and SQL skills for accelerated career growth in tech and analytics roles.
* **Dr. Finance** ()Delivers structured personal finance education, enabling individuals to make informed decisions around saving, investing, and wealth creation.
* **Profit Uni** ()Provides applied stock market and trading education, focusing on practical strategies, risk management, and consistent profitability.
* **Springpad** ()Offers specialized programs in analytics and business intelligence, empowering learners with job\-ready, insight\-driven skills.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic **Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team in Kolkata. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about talent acquisition to work in a high\-growth EdTech environment and contribute to building world\-class teams.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Sourcing \& Strategy**

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top candidates
* Utilize multiple channels such as job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networks to source candidates
* Identify new and creative ways to reach out to potential candidates
* Research and implement innovative recruiting techniques
* Leverage employer branding to attract quality talent
* Create compelling job postings and recruitment advertisements

**Candidate Screening \& Shortlisting**

* Review resumes and applications to identify the best talent
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and culture fit
* Assess candidate qualifications against job requirements
* Maintain timely and professional communication with all applicants
* Shortlist candidates efficiently to move them through the hiring funnel
* Evaluate both technical skills and cultural alignment

**Interview Coordination \& Process Management**

* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and hiring managers
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics and communications
* Gather and document interview feedback to facilitate smooth decision\-making
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Track candidate progress through recruitment stages
* Follow up with candidates and provide timely updates

**Building \& Maintaining Talent Pipelines**

* Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs
* Engage with passive candidates and develop long\-term relationships with potential hires
* Create talent pools segmented by role, skills, and experience level
* Keep track of industry hiring trends and market conditions
* Nurture candidate relationships for future opportunities
* Stay updated on salary benchmarks and competitive landscape

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* Represent the company in a professional and engaging manner
* Actively contribute to enhancing the employer brand by ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Promote House of EdTech as a great place to work through social media, networking events, and recruitment campaigns
* Showcase company culture and values to attract the right talent
* Gather candidate feedback to improve recruitment experience
* Participate in job fairs, campus placements, and networking events

**Recruitment Analytics \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate reports on key hiring metrics
* Use data\-driven insights to optimize recruitment strategies and improve hiring efficiency
* Track metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and conversion rates
* Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment status
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (ATS) effectively
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

**Required Skills \& QualificationsMust\-Have Skills \& Experience**

* **Experience** – 1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar HR role
* **Recruitment Knowledge** – Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, and hiring best practices
* **Communication** – Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* **Multitasking** – Ability to manage multiple job openings and prioritize tasks effectively
* **Technical Proficiency** – Proficiency in using job portals, LinkedIn, and applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* **Interpersonal Skills** – Strong interpersonal skills to engage with candidates and stakeholders effectively

**Core Competencies**

* **Sourcing Excellence** – Creative and effective in finding and attracting talent
* **Candidate Assessment** – Strong interviewing and evaluation skills
* **Relationship Building** – Ability to build rapport with candidates and hiring managers
* **Organization** – Excellent organizational and time management skills
* **Adaptability** – Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* **Attention to Detail** – Meticulous in candidate screening and documentation
* **Proactive Approach** – Self\-starter who takes initiative

**Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)**

* Experience working in the EdTech industry or fast\-growing startups
* Knowledge of HR software and recruitment tools
* Experience in campus hiring, bulk hiring, or leadership hiring
* Exposure to technical recruitment
* Understanding of compensation benchmarking
* Certification in HR or recruitment (SHRM, HRCI, etc.)
* Experience with employer branding initiatives

**What We OfferCareer Growth \& Development**

* **Career Growth** – We invest in your development through mentorship programs, training sessions, and career advancement opportunities
* **Skill Enhancement** – Learn advanced recruitment techniques and talent strategies
* **Clear Progression** – Path to senior TA roles and HR leadership positions
* **Learning Opportunities** – Exposure to diverse roles and hiring across multiple functions

**Work Culture \& Environment**

* **Work Culture** – A supportive, energetic, and collaborative work environment where your ideas are valued
* **Dynamic Team** – Work with 2,000\+ passionate professionals across the organization
* **Modern Office** – Well\-equipped office in Kolkata with professional amenities
* **Inclusive Environment** – Diverse and inclusive workplace culture

**Brand Exposure \& Impact**

* **Diverse Portfolio** – Work with leading brands such as:
* Springpad
* Be10x
* Profit Uni
* Office Master
* Mad About Sports
* Dr. Finance
* AI for Techies
* **Business Impact** – Play a key role in building teams that serve 5 million\+ learners
* **Mission\-Driven** – Contribute to democratizing education by hiring the best talent

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits** – Attractive salary (₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA), performance incentives, and employee perks
* **Performance Recognition** – Rewards for successful hiring and contributions
* **Growth Potential** – Clear salary progression based on performance

**Additional Benefits**

* Opportunity to shape talent acquisition processes and strategies
* Professional network building in EdTech and HR community
* Exposure to recruitment across sales, tech, content, operations, and more
* Structured onboarding and training program
* Recognition as a key contributor to organizational growth

**Why Join House of EdTech?**

At House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP), we are on a mission to empower learners and professionals through innovative educational solutions. Join our team of dynamic employees and be part of a company that values growth, learning, and innovation.

We're not just hiring recruiters—we're building a talent acquisition function that will support our ambitious growth plans and help us reach millions more learners across India and beyond.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONGeneral Manager – HospitalPosition Details

**Designation:** General Manager – Hospital  
**Department:** Hospital Administration / Operations  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO / Hospital Director  
**Location:** Hospital  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

The General Manager will be responsible for the **overall operational, administrative, financial, and service management** of the hospital. The role involves ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning of all departments, maintaining high standards of patient care and service quality, managing employees and resources, ensuring regulatory and accreditation compliance, and supporting the hospital's growth and financial performance.

The General Manager will act as a key link between the **Management, Medical Team, Nursing, Administration, Finance, HR, Engineering, Operations, and Support Services**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Hospital Operations

* Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the hospital and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Ensure efficient utilization of hospital infrastructure, manpower, equipment, and other resources.
* Monitor patient flow, admissions, discharges, OPD, IPD, emergency, diagnostics, pharmacy, and support services.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential hospital services.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve operational issues promptly.
* Develop and implement SOPs, policies, and operational procedures.

2\. Patient Experience \& Service Quality

* Ensure high standards of **patient care, safety, satisfaction, and service quality**.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, grievances, and service recovery.
* Establish systems to improve patient experience and reduce waiting times.
* Ensure professional and courteous behavior by all hospital staff.
* Conduct regular rounds and review service standards across departments.

3\. Financial \& Business Management

* Monitor hospital revenue, expenses, profitability, and operating costs.
* Work closely with the Finance Department to prepare and monitor budgets.
* Review department\-wise financial performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Monitor billing, collections, credit management, insurance/TPA processes, and revenue leakage.
* Control unnecessary expenditure while maintaining quality of services.
* Support development of new revenue streams and business opportunities.
* Review monthly MIS and key financial indicators with management.

4\. Human Resources \& Team Management

* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, manpower planning, training, performance management, and employee retention.
* Ensure appropriate staffing levels across departments.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity, and performance.
* Develop leadership and accountability among department heads.
* Conduct regular review meetings with HODs and key personnel.
* Promote teamwork, professional conduct, and a positive workplace culture.

5\. Medical \& Clinical Coordination

* Coordinate with the Medical Director, Consultants, Nursing Head, and Clinical HODs for smooth clinical operations.
* Facilitate resolution of operational issues affecting clinical departments.
* Ensure availability of required clinical support services.
* Support implementation of clinical quality and patient\-safety initiatives.
* Ensure proper coordination between clinical and non\-clinical departments.

6\. Quality, Accreditation \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable **healthcare laws, statutory requirements, hospital regulations, and accreditation standards**.
* Coordinate hospital quality and accreditation initiatives such as NABH or other applicable standards.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs, quality indicators, audits, corrective actions, and risk\-management programs.
* Ensure proper documentation and readiness for internal and external inspections.
* Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety.

7\. Facility \& Infrastructure Management

* Oversee Engineering, Maintenance, Housekeeping, Security, Laundry, Dietary, Biomedical, Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, and other support services.
* Ensure proper maintenance of hospital buildings, infrastructure, equipment, and utilities.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and breakdown response.
* Ensure adequate safety, cleanliness, infection\-control support, and environmental standards.
* Coordinate hospital expansion, renovation, and infrastructure projects where required.

8\. Vendor \& Procurement Management

* Oversee procurement and vendor\-management activities in coordination with authorized departments.
* Evaluate vendor performance, quality, pricing, and service levels.
* Ensure timely availability of essential materials, consumables, and services.
* Support negotiation with vendors and service providers.
* Ensure appropriate inventory control and reduction of wastage.

9\. Safety, Risk \& Emergency Management

* Ensure implementation of hospital safety policies and emergency preparedness plans.
* Coordinate disaster management, fire safety, security, and emergency response systems.
* Monitor incident reports and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and mock drills as required.
* Ensure patient, staff, visitor, and hospital property safety.

10\. MIS \& Management Reporting

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators such as:
* OPD \& IPD volumes
* Bed occupancy
* Average length of stay
* Revenue
* Patient satisfaction
* OT utilization
* Diagnostic utilization
* Pharmacy performance
* Collection efficiency
* Employee productivity
* Complaints and grievances
* Present performance reports and improvement plans to senior management.

11\. Business Development

* Support the hospital's business growth and market\-development strategies.
* Develop relationships with corporates, insurance companies, TPAs, doctors, referral networks, and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for new services, specialties, and partnerships.
* Support marketing and community outreach initiatives.
* Monitor competitor activities and local healthcare market trends.

Qualifications

* **MBA / PG Diploma in Hospital Management / Healthcare Management / Hospital Administration** preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline; candidates with **MBBS, BHA, BHM, BBA, or related qualifications** may also be considered based on experience.
* Strong knowledge of hospital operations and healthcare administration.
* Knowledge of NABH/accreditation requirements is preferred.
* Strong understanding of hospital finance, HR, quality, and operational processes.

Experience

**Preferred:** 8–15 years of relevant experience in hospital administration/operations, with significant experience in a managerial or leadership position.

Experience in managing a **multi\-specialty hospital** will be an advantage.

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939\. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk\-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry\-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient. At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.


**Role Overview**



The Proposals Coordinator supports the Capture \+ Proposal Marketing function by coordinating and contributing to proposal development and production, direct marketing initiatives, and other business development activities across the region. Working closely with the Strategy and Business Development team, the role provides support for major opportunities and proposals, while also developing and maintaining marketing materials to support day\-to\-day business operations. The position may also provide support in areas such as sales and business development, vendor coordination, market research, and other regional initiatives as required. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.



The role offers hybrid and remote working options, subject to business requirements and team needs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support regional proposal team by managing the proposal activities.
* Organize, produce, and assemble proposal submissions, including RFI's, RFQ's, RFP's, SOQ's, marketing collateral and vendor registrations
* Manage aspects of proposal coordination related to creation of proposal templates and draft proposals for review by the regional operations team while adhering to established Jensen Hughes Brand guidelines
* Contribute to building a repository of proposal materials specific to regional needs and collaborate with the creative team to obtain project and stock imagery for proposal submissions
* Update client and project information in the marketing project and personnel database, including project descriptions, staff resume updates and other shared knowledge used by the proposal team
* Assist in other marketing and/or business development areas as requested or assigned
* Develop capability statements in MS word and InDesign
* Liaise with internal technical experts to update Resume Short Bios, Expert Finder information and other subject matter expert information for Website
* Effectively collaborates between marketing communication, creative, proposal team internationally to update marketing resources


**Requirements and Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree (B.S.) from a four\-year college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, with 3–5\+ years of relevant experience in a similar industry, preferably within the engineering, architecture, construction, or B2B professional services environment
* Prior experience working within an architecture, engineering, construction (AEC) firm or a related professional services organization is preferred
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and developing responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, including preparing proposal content, developing marketing collateral, coordinating deliverables, and conducting thorough quality control and proofreading
* Ability to manage multiple proposals, deadlines, teaming arrangements, and client\-specific templates simultaneously. Skilled in developing proposal checklists, coordinating with stakeholders across project management, contracts/legal, HR, compliance, and finance, and proactively managing changing priorities to meet deadlines
* Experience developing and maintaining case studies, brochures, newsletters, website project profiles, and other internal and external marketing communications, while ensuring content is engaging, accurate, polished, and aligned with corporate brand guidelines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams), with MS Planner experience considered an advantage. Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and InDesign, including the ability to work with and maintain branded templates
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and professionally to internal and external stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, organization, and proofreading skills are essential, along with the flexibility to work extended hours occasionally to meet critical deadlines


**Why you should join Jensen Hughes**

  

* You will work on exciting, challenging and at times groundbreaking projects with market\-leading clients whilst having the backing of a leading international firm.
* There is continued support from the leadership team with a measured and flexible approach to carrying out day to day activities.
* Career advancement with an established framework is in place – clearly defining expectations and outlining opportunities for advancement.

Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.

title: Proposals Coordinator
description:
**Company Overview**



Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939\. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk\-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry\-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient. At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.


**Role Overview**



The Proposals Coordinator supports the Capture \+ Proposal Marketing function by coordinating and contributing to proposal development and production, direct marketing initiatives, and other business development activities across the region. Working closely with the Strategy and Business Development team, the role provides support for major opportunities and proposals, while also developing and maintaining marketing materials to support day\-to\-day business operations. The position may also provide support in areas such as sales and business development, vendor coordination, market research, and other regional initiatives as required. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.



The role offers hybrid and remote working options, subject to business requirements and team needs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support regional proposal team by managing the proposal activities.
* Organize, produce, and assemble proposal submissions, including RFI's, RFQ's, RFP's, SOQ's, marketing collateral and vendor registrations
* Manage aspects of proposal coordination related to creation of proposal templates and draft proposals for review by the regional operations team while adhering to established Jensen Hughes Brand guidelines
* Contribute to building a repository of proposal materials specific to regional needs and collaborate with the creative team to obtain project and stock imagery for proposal submissions
* Update client and project information in the marketing project and personnel database, including project descriptions, staff resume updates and other shared knowledge used by the proposal team
* Assist in other marketing and/or business development areas as requested or assigned
* Develop capability statements in MS word and InDesign
* Liaise with internal technical experts to update Resume Short Bios, Expert Finder information and other subject matter expert information for Website
* Effectively collaborates between marketing communication, creative, proposal team internationally to update marketing resources


**Requirements and Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree (B.S.) from a four\-year college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, with 3–5\+ years of relevant experience in a similar industry, preferably within the engineering, architecture, construction, or B2B professional services environment
* Prior experience working within an architecture, engineering, construction (AEC) firm or a related professional services organization is preferred
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and developing responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, including preparing proposal content, developing marketing collateral, coordinating deliverables, and conducting thorough quality control and proofreading
* Ability to manage multiple proposals, deadlines, teaming arrangements, and client\-specific templates simultaneously. Skilled in developing proposal checklists, coordinating with stakeholders across project management, contracts/legal, HR, compliance, and finance, and proactively managing changing priorities to meet deadlines
* Experience developing and maintaining case studies, brochures, newsletters, website project profiles, and other internal and external marketing communications, while ensuring content is engaging, accurate, polished, and aligned with corporate brand guidelines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams), with MS Planner experience considered an advantage. Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and InDesign, including the ability to work with and maintain branded templates
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and professionally to internal and external stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, organization, and proofreading skills are essential, along with the flexibility to work extended hours occasionally to meet critical deadlines


**Why you should join Jensen Hughes**

  

* You will work on exciting, challenging and at times groundbreaking projects with market\-leading clients whilst having the backing of a leading international firm.
* There is continued support from the leadership team with a measured and flexible approach to carrying out day to day activities.
* Career advancement with an established framework is in place – clearly defining expectations and outlining opportunities for advancement.

***Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.***

  



At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate. We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process. Please click **here** to review.

  

The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data. Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA. Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.

  


* Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements

  

Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee\-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to "staffing firms" or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.

**We are looking for a Bright Mind who Loves Learning, People \& Problem Solving**

We are creating a **Training \& Innovation Lab in Thiruvananthapuram** to develop young people into capable business professionals.

We are looking for someone who can eventually help **run the Lab, organise people, build systems and make things happen.**

This is not a conventional HR or administration job.

You will be exposed to **business development, people management, training, operations, AI, digital tools and entrepreneurship.**

**Your Role**

During the initial four months, you will learn and gradually take responsibility for:

* Organising and running the Training Lab
* Coordinating young trainees and team members
* Planning training programmes
* Recruiting Sales\& Marketing personnel.
* Developing induction and training processes
* Understanding business operations
* Supporting NETIMPAKT implementation and promotion
* Customer and business communication

* Recruitment coordination and people development
* Preparing presentations, documents and training material
* Using AI to improve everyday business work
* Researching new opportunities and solutions
* Identifying problems and finding practical solutions
* Helping the team become more productive and professional

You will work closely with the technical/creative trainee and together you will build the capabilities required to operate the Lab.

**We would particularly value someone who:**

* Is intelligent, curious and energetic
* Enjoys working with people
* Has excellent communication skills
* Can organise things and get people moving
* Thinks independently
* Enjoys solving problems
* Is comfortable learning technology and AI
* Can take responsibility rather than waiting for instructions
* Can teach others what they have learned
* Is interested in business, management and entrepreneurship

A degree in **Management, Commerce, Business, Engineering, Computer Applications, Psychology, Communications or a related field** may be useful, but **attitude and learning ability are more important than the degree.**

**The Bigger Opportunity**

The first four months are a **learning and proving period**.

We expect you to progress from:

**Learner → Coordinator → Trainer → Responsible Manager**

You will be expected to gradually take ownership of people, processes and outcomes.

If you successfully demonstrate the required capability, commitment and responsibility, you will move into a **Management Trainee position at ₹20,000 per month** after four months.

The longer\-term objective is for you to become one of the people who can **help run the Lab, train young professionals and manage business operations.**

**We are not looking for someone who merely wants a job.**  
**We are looking for someone who wants to become capable of running things.**

Should have your own laptop and ready to join immediately.

title: Compliance Manager
description:
**Compliance Manager**

**Department:** Compliance

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Reporting To:** CFO / CEO

**Role:** Compliance Manager / Head – Compliance

**1\. Job Purpose**

To lead and ensure end\-to\-end statutory, regulatory, food safety, factory, labour, licensing and business compliance across manufacturing units, offices, warehouses, distribution centres and other business locations.

The role will be responsible for identifying compliance requirements, maintaining statutory records and licences, coordinating inspections and audits, ensuring timely renewals/returns, monitoring compliance gaps and driving corrective actions to minimise legal, financial and operational risks.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Food Safety \& FSSAI Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable **FSSAI requirements** across manufacturing, retail, warehouses and food\-service operations.
* Ensure timely renewal, modification and updating of FSSAI licences.
* Coordinate with Quality, Production, R\&D and Operations teams for food safety compliance.
* Monitor food safety documentation, hygiene standards, pest control, sanitation, water testing, product testing and related records.
* Ensure Food Safety Supervisors/FoSTaC requirements are complied with wherever applicable.
* Coordinate FSSAI inspections, audits and regulatory visits and ensure closure of observations.
* Maintain product traceability, complaint records, recall\-related documentation and corrective/preventive actions.
* Monitor compliance relating to food labelling, declarations and packaging requirements in coordination with Quality/R\&D.

FSSAI specifically identifies FSMS, GMP and GHP as important requirements for licensed food businesses, including manufacturing, processing, packaging, storage and distribution.

**B. Factory \& Labour Law Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable **Factories Act / OSH requirements and Karnataka factory regulations**.
* Maintain factory licences, registrations, statutory registers and returns.
* Monitor compliance relating to:
* Working hours
* Overtime
* Weekly offs
* Leave
* Wages
* Employment conditions
* Welfare facilities
* Health and safety
* Cafeteria
* First aid
* Accident reporting
* Safety committee requirements
* Coordinate factory inspections and government authority visits.
* Ensure timely closure of observations raised by statutory authorities.

**C. Labour \& Employment Compliance**

* Monitor compliance with applicable labour laws across all locations.
* Ensure compliance relating to **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Payment of Wages and Contract Labour**.
* Review statutory payroll compliance in coordination with HR and Finance.
* Verify compliance of manpower contractors and third\-party agencies.
* Ensure contractors maintain required wage registers, attendance records, PF/ESI records, licences and statutory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits of manpower vendors.

**D. Shops \& Establishments / Retail Compliance**

* Ensure compliance for all manufacturing units, retail outlets, offices and other applicable establishments.
* Maintain Shops \& Establishments registrations and related statutory documentation.
* Track renewal dates, inspections and statutory returns.
* Ensure statutory notices and mandatory displays are maintained at all locations.

**E. Legal Metrology \& Product Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable **Legal Metrology requirements** for packaged products.
* Coordinate verification/stamping of weighing instruments wherever applicable.
* Review product packaging declarations in coordination with Quality, R\&D and Marketing.
* Ensure correct declarations relating to MRP, net quantity, manufacturer/packer details, consumer care information and other applicable requirements.
* Monitor compliance of packaging and labelling across SKUs.

**F. Licences \& Registrations Management**

Maintain a central **Compliance \& Licence Master** covering all company locations, including:

* FSSAI licences
* Factory licences
* Shops \& Establishments registrations
* Trade licences
* Fire NOC / Fire Safety compliance
* Pollution Control Board consents
* Legal Metrology registrations
* Professional Tax
* Labour Welfare Fund
* PF / ESI registrations
* Contract Labour licences
* Weights \& Measures
* Local municipal licences
* Any other business\-specific statutory registrations

Ensure **zero lapse in licence validity** through advance renewal planning.

**3\. Audit \& Compliance Monitoring**

* Develop an annual compliance audit calendar.
* Conduct periodic compliance audits across manufacturing units, warehouses and offices.
* Prepare location\-wise compliance checklists.
* Identify gaps and assign corrective actions with timelines.
* Follow up with respective department heads until closure.
* Maintain evidence/documentation for all closed observations.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly compliance reports for senior management.

**4\. Regulatory \& Government Liaison**

* Act as the primary compliance coordinator with statutory and regulatory authorities.
* Coordinate inspections, notices, hearings and regulatory correspondence.
* Maintain proper records of government communications.
* Ensure timely responses to notices and observations.
* Escalate critical legal or regulatory risks to management immediately.

**5\. Legal \& Risk Management**

* Coordinate with external legal counsel on compliance\-related matters.
* Review compliance implications of new business initiatives, new locations, products and processes.
* Support HR in employee\-related legal matters, disciplinary actions and statutory compliance.
* Support management in handling labour disputes, regulatory notices and government proceedings.
* Maintain a **Compliance Risk Register** and track high\-risk areas.

**6\. POSH \& Workplace Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable POSH requirements.
* Maintain Internal Committee documentation.
* Coordinate POSH awareness/training programmes.
* Ensure statutory reporting and documentation are completed within applicable timelines.
* Support HR in maintaining workplace conduct and statutory documentation.

**7\. Vendor \& Third\-Party Compliance**

* Establish minimum compliance requirements for contractors and vendors.
* Conduct periodic compliance verification of:
* Housekeeping vendors
* Security agencies
* Manpower contractors
* Transporters
* Facility management vendors
* Food/service vendors
* Ensure required statutory documents are collected and periodically validated.
* Flag non\-compliant vendors to Procurement/Finance/Management.

**8\. Compliance MIS \& Reporting**

Prepare and present a monthly **Management Compliance Dashboard** covering:

* Licence status
* Upcoming renewals
* Statutory returns
* Statutory payments
* Audit observations
* Open/closed compliance gaps
* Government notices
* Labour compliance
* Contractor compliance
* Food safety compliance
* Fire \& safety compliance
* High\-risk compliance matters

**4\. Qualification**

**For Compliance Manager:**

* Graduate/Post Graduate in Law, Commerce, HR, Food Technology, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 8–15 years of relevant compliance experience, preferably in **FMCG / Food Manufacturing / Retail / Hospitality**.
* Strong exposure to food manufacturing, factory compliance, labour laws and multi\-location compliance.
* Experience in managing regulatory authorities, audits and legal/compliance risks.

**5\. Experience \& Skills**

**Mandatory Experience**

* Food/FMCG/manufacturing compliance
* FSSAI compliance
* Factory compliance
* Labour law compliance
* Statutory licences and renewals
* Contract labour compliance
* Compliance audits
* Government liaison
* Legal Metrology
* Multi\-location compliance

**Key Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian statutory and regulatory requirements
* Excellent documentation and record\-management skills
* Strong audit and inspection handling capability
* Strong follow\-up and closure orientation
* Excellent communication and drafting skills
* Ability to work independently with senior management
* Strong coordination with HR, Finance, Quality, Production, Operations and Procurement

He/She should be capable of visiting the **manufacturing units, DCs and other locations**, identifying compliance gaps on the ground, coordinating with department heads and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.

The person should also be comfortable interacting with **FSSAI, Labour Department, Factory Inspectorate, Legal Metrology, Fire Department, Pollution Control Board and other government authorities**.

Pay: From ₹130,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

About the Role \-

TUANZ is looking for a highly driven and hands\-on Retail Operations \& Business Manager to take ownership of the overall performance of our multi\-store retail business.

This is a sales\-driven business management role, not just an administrative or store operations position.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing multiple TUANZ stores, driving revenue growth, managing Store Managers and teams, improving store productivity, coordinating with Head Office departments, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day business operations.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions, solve problems independently and drive the business toward its sales and profitability goals.

Key Responsibilities

Sales \& Business Growth

\- Take ownership of overall monthly sales targets across all TUANZ stores.

\- Drive store\-wise revenue growth and ensure achievement of targets.

\- Analyse underperforming stores and implement corrective action plans.

\- Monitor key retail KPIs including conversion, average transaction value, walk\-ins and staff productivity.

\- Identify opportunities to increase repeat business and customer retention.

\- Develop practical initiatives to improve store sales and profitability.

Multi\-Store Operations

\- Oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of all TUANZ retail outlets.

\- Conduct regular store visits and performance reviews.

\- Ensure company SOPs, customer service standards and operational discipline are followed.

\- Ensure appropriate staffing, grooming, store hygiene and visual merchandising standards.

\- Resolve operational issues independently and escalate only important matters to management.

**Team Leadership :** 

\- Manage and review Store Managers and retail teams.

\- Conduct structured weekly performance reviews.

\- Set clear targets and action points for individual stores.

\- Monitor staff productivity and identify training requirements.

\- Build a strong culture of accountability, discipline and sales performance.

\- Coordinate with HR for recruitment and manpower requirements.

**Stock \& Merchandising :**

\- Coordinate with the inventory team to ensure adequate stock availability across stores.

\- Monitor replenishment and stock shortages affecting sales.

\- Review ageing and slow\-moving inventory.

\- Ensure appropriate product assortment and merchandising across locations.

\- Provide management with store\-level feedback regarding customer demand and product movement.

**Marketing \& E\-Commerce Coordination :**

\- Coordinate with the Marketing and E\-Commerce teams/agencies from a business perspective.

\- Ensure promotions and campaigns are properly executed across stores.

\- Provide feedback on customer behaviour, products, offers and market trends.

\- Coordinate online and offline initiatives to support overall TUANZ revenue growth.

**MIS \& Management Reporting :**

\- Review Target vs Actual sales performance weekly.

\- Identify gaps and prepare corrective action plans.

\- Track agreed retail KPIs and action points.

\- Provide management with a concise weekly business performance report.

\- Ensure decisions and action points are followed through to completion.

**Candidate Profile :**

We are looking for candidates with:

\- 5–8 years of relevant retail experience.

\- Experience managing multiple retail outlets is strongly preferred.

\- Experience managing Store Managers and sales teams.

\- Strong understanding of sales targets and retail KPIs.

\- Proven ability to improve store sales and team productivity.

\- Strong leadership and people\-management skills.

\- Good understanding of inventory, merchandising and customer experience.

\- Ability to take independent day\-to\-day business decisions.

\- Strong problem\-solving and execution skills.

\- Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and MIS reporting.

\- Good written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Industry Experience :**

Candidates from Jewellery, Fashion, Accessories, Watches, Beauty, Luxury or Premium Lifestyle Retail will be preferred.

Jewellery retail experience will be an added advantage.

**Compensation :** Fixed Salary: ₹50,000 – ₹55,000 per month

Performance Incentive: Up to ₹30,000 per month based on achievement of defined sales and business performance targets.

High\-performing candidates will therefore have the opportunity to earn up to approximately ₹80,000 – ₹85,000 per month.

**Who Should Apply?**

This role is ideal for a retail professional who wants to move beyond managing a single store and take business\-level responsibility for a growing multi\-store jewellery brand.

You should be comfortable being accountable for:

Sales → Stores → People → Stock → Execution → Business Performance

We are looking for a doer and business driver, not someone who only prepares reports.

If you have successfully managed multiple retail stores, led teams, achieved sales targets and believe you can take ownership of growing a retail business, we would like to hear from you.

Responsible for handling the back\-office billing process — generating invoices, verifying payment entries, reconciling accounts, and maintaining accurate billing records to support the collections and finance teams.

* Generate invoices/bills for clients and customers based on service, loan, or account details

* Support the accounts/finance team during month\-end closing with billing data
* Maintain proper documentation for audit and compliance purposes
* Respond to internal queries from telecallers/field team regarding a customer's billing status

Requirements

* Prior experience in billing, back\-office, or accounts support role preferred
* Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic formulas) for reconciliation work
* High attention to detail — this role is the accuracy check before/after collections
* Basic understanding of invoicing/billing cycles and payment terms

Nice to have

title: Group Vice President Human Resources
description:
**GROUP VICE PRESIDENT** 

  
 




**HUMAN RESOURCES** 




*Enterprise People Leadership • Culture • Capability • Compliance* 




  





**About Star Worldwide Group** 




 Star Worldwide Group is an India\-headquartered integrated services group providing domestic and international relocation, global mobility, fine art and exhibition handling, specialized logistics, information and records management, storage and related technology\-enabled solutions. The Group serves corporate, institutional and individual customers through a network of offices in major Indian cities and global alliance partners.
 



 • Customer promise: precise execution, responsible custody, service consistency and a high\-quality experience across every customer touchpoint.
 



 • Operating context: a distributed, service\-intensive workforce spanning corporate functions, branch offices, warehouses, field operations and specialist handling teams.
 



 • Growth agenda: strengthen leadership depth, scalable systems, digital ways of working, compliance discipline and performance\-led culture.
 



 • Values emphasis: professionalism, integrity, customer centricity, innovation, quality, safety and responsible business practices.
 



  





**Leadership Mandate** 




 The Group Vice President – Human Resources will be the enterprise people leader for Star Worldwide Group. The role will translate business strategy into a practical people agenda, build leadership capability, strengthen organizational effectiveness and ensure reliable HR governance across entities and locations. This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring equal confidence in boardroom discussions and frontline operating environments.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**1\. Enterprise HR Strategy \& Governance** 




 • Create a three\-year people strategy and annual operating plan aligned to the Group’s business priorities, service model and growth ambitions.
 



 • Advise Board and business leadership on organization, talent, workforce cost, risk and change priorities.
 



 • Establish a clear HR governance rhythm covering workforce plans, talent, succession, employee relations, compliance, people, metrics and priority interventions.
 



 • Clarify HR operating roles across corporate HR, business leaders, branch teams and external partners; build a service\-oriented HR function with defined SLAs.
 



  





**2\. Organization Design, Workforce Planning \& Productivity** 




 • Lead organization design, role clarity, spans and layers review, manpower planning and workforce productivity initiatives across corporate and operating teams.
 



 • Create a disciplined position\-control and hiring\-approval process linked to budgets, capacity requirements and business cases.
 



 • Partner with Finance and business heads on workforce cost planning, deployment, overtime, contract labour governance and productivity improvement.
 



 • Ensure job architecture, job descriptions, grade structures and career paths are clear, consistent and scalable.
 



  





**3\. Leadership, Talent \& Succession** 




 • Build a leadership competency framework and use it for selection, assessment, development and succession decisions.
 



 • Run periodic talent reviews for critical roles, identify successors and develop evidence\-based individual development plans.
 



 • Coach senior leaders on team effectiveness, accountability, difficult conversations and change leadership.
 



 • Create capability academies for managers, frontline supervisors, customer\-facing teams and specialist operational roles.
 



  





**4\. Performance, Rewards \& PLI** 




 • Design and institutionalize a KRA/KPI\-based performance management system with role scorecards, goal calibration, mid\-year reviews and fair year\-end decisions.
 



 • Link Performance Linked Incentive plans to a balanced set of financial, customer, operational, people and compliance outcomes, with clear thresholds and governance.
 



 • Lead compensation benchmarking, annual increment and promotion cycles, internal equity reviews and recognition programmes within approved budgets.
 



 • Build manager capability to differentiate performance, document outcomes and provide constructive feedback.
 



  





**5\. Talent Acquisition, Employer Brand \& Retention** 




 • Own workforce acquisition strategy for leadership, specialist, corporate, branch and ground operations roles.
 



 • Improve hiring quality, speed, source effectiveness, candidate experience and joining conversion through measurable recruitment governance.
 



 • Build succession and talent pipelines for business\-critical and hard\-to\-fill roles; use structured selection and reference\-check practices.
 



 • Analyze regrettable attrition and early\-tenure exits; sponsor practical retention actions by role, location and talent segment.
 



  





**6\. Culture, Engagement \& Employee Relations** 




 • Define and embed leadership behaviours and workplace practices that reinforce accountability, collaboration, customer focus, safety and respect.
 



 • Establish credible listening channels, grievance redressal, disciplinary governance, whistleblowing coordination and employee communication routines.
 



 • Strengthen engagement for field and ground operations employees through visible leadership, supervisor capability and locally relevant interventions.
 



 • Lead sensitive employee relations matters with fairness, confidentiality, documentation and timely escalation.
 



  





**7\. Compliance, Industrial Relations, Safety \& POSH** 




 • Own the HR compliance framework across locations and entities, including applicable labour laws, registrations, licences, notices, registers, returns and inspections.
 



 • Ensure governance of wages, working hours, leave, contractor workforce, social security, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, maternity benefits and statutory records, as applicable.
 



 • Maintain effective POSH governance, including policy, Internal Committee support, awareness, reporting, confidentiality and timely case administration.
 



 • Partner with Operations and EHS on workforce safety, welfare, accident reporting, training and corrective actions; maintain audit\-ready evidence.
 



 • Monitor legislative changes and obtain specialist legal advice for complex matters. The role is accountable for governance, not a substitute for legal counsel.
 



  





**8\. HR Technology, Data \& Operating Excellence** 




 • Lead selection, implementation and adoption of an integrated HRIS covering employee master data, attendance, payroll interfaces, recruitment, performance, learning and analytics.
 



 • Establish data ownership, access controls, audit trails, document retention and privacy\-conscious people\-data practices.
 



 • Create a monthly people dashboard and convert workforce data into decisions, interventions and accountable follow\-through.
 



 • Simplify HR policies, SOPs and employee journeys while maintaining control, consistency and service quality.
 



  





**9\. Change, Integration \& Business Partnership** 




 • Lead the people workstream for expansion, restructuring, new locations, system rollouts, acquisitions or business integration, as applicable.
 



 • Build change plans covering stakeholder alignment, communication, capability, adoption, risk and benefit tracking.
 



 • Serve as a pragmatic business partner who challenges constructively, makes trade\-offs visible and follows decisions through to execution.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 • Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or related discipline.
 



 • Approximately 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5–7\+ years leading an HR function or a substantial business HR portfolio.
 



 • Demonstrated experience with both white\-collar and blue\-collar / frontline workforces in a multi\-location, service\-intensive environment.
 



 • Strong command of organization design, workforce planning, performance and rewards, talent acquisition, leadership development, employee relations and HR operations.
 



 • Practical knowledge of Indian labour and employment compliance, PF, ESI, POSH, contractor governance and audit management.
 



 • Experience implementing HR technology and building reliable people analytics and governance routines.
 



 • Industry background in logistics, supply chain, transportation, services, retail, warehousing or manufacturing is preferred.
 



 • Executive presence, commercial acumen, high integrity, sound judgement and the ability to influence while remaining hands\-on.
 



  





**Role Relationships** 




**Reports to:** 
 Group leadership / designated executive sponsor
 



**Direct team:** 
 HR Manager and HR support team; structure to be reviewed by the incumbent
 



**Key stakeholders:** 
 Chairman, JMD, CFO, business and functional leaders, branch and operations heads, Finance, Legal, EHS, IT and external advisors
 



**Travel:** 
 Travel to operating locations may be required

**About HI Labs**

HI Labs is building serious, outcome\-focused technology education programs for students who want to become industry\-ready software engineers.

Our programs focus on **strong computer science fundamentals, practical software development, AI\-native engineering practices, real\-world projects, discipline, and internship readiness.**

We believe students should not just learn how to write code. They should understand **how and why software works**, develop strong problem\-solving skills, and learn how to approach problems like engineers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Software Mentor/Faculty Trainee** who is passionate about software development, enjoys helping others learn, and wants to develop strong skills in both **software engineering and technical mentoring**.

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will work with students and the academic team to help learners understand programming, computer science fundamentals, software development concepts, assignments, and projects.

This is **not a traditional coding trainer role**. You will be expected to understand concepts deeply and gradually learn how to explain them clearly, guide students through problems, review their work, and connect theoretical concepts with practical software development.

This role is particularly suitable for **fresh graduates, recent graduates, developers with 0–2 years of experience, and candidates with strong technical fundamentals who are interested in teaching or mentoring.**

**Key Areas You May Work With**

Depending on your skills and program requirements, you may work on the following areas:

**Programming \& Problem Solving**

* Programming fundamentals
* Logic building
* Problem\-solving techniques
* Code reading and debugging
* Basic algorithmic thinking
* Programming exercises

**Computer Science Fundamentals**

* Data Structures \& Algorithms
* Database Management Systems

* Operating Systems fundamentals
* Computer Networks basics
* Software Engineering principles

**Software Development**

* JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals

title: Software Tester
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and experienced Software Tester to join our Quality Assurance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, functionality, and performance of software applications before they are released to customers.
 



  





 As a Software Tester, you will work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, and other QA professionals to understand requirements, create comprehensive test scenarios, identify defects, and ensure that applications meet both functional and business expectations.
 



  





 The role provides an opportunity to work across different stages of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) while contributing to the delivery of high\-quality software products.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Analyze business and technical requirements to understand application functionality
 



 Prepare detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test data
 



 Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, and sanity testing
 



 Execute manual test cases across web, mobile, and software applications
 



 Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects
 



 Re\-test resolved defects and perform regression testing after fixes
 



 Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve application issues
 



 Validate application functionality against defined business requirements
 



 Perform cross\-browser and cross\-device testing
 



 Conduct API testing using tools such as Postman
 



 Perform basic database validation using SQL queries
 



 Participate in release testing and provide quality assessments
 



 Maintain accurate testing documentation and defect reports
 



 Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint planning activities
 



 Contribute to improving QA processes, testing standards, and methodologies
 



 Assist in identifying opportunities for test automation
 



 Monitor application quality throughout the development lifecycle
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 1–4 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance
 



 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field
 



 Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC
 



 Hands\-on experience with Manual Testing
 



 Good knowledge of functional and non\-functional testing concepts
 



 Experience creating and executing test cases and test scenarios
 



 Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, or similar
 



 Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL
 



 Understanding of API testing and REST APIs
 



 Familiarity with Postman or similar API testing tools
 



 Strong knowledge of defect life cycle and QA processes
 



 Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



 Strong attention to detail
 



 Good written and verbal communication skills
 



 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment
 



  





**What You'll Gain** 




  





 Hands\-on experience with real\-world software testing projects
 



 Exposure to complete QA and SDLC processes
 



 Opportunity to work with modern testing tools and technologies
 



 Experience with API and database testing
 



 Exposure to test automation and CI/CD environments
 



 Collaboration with experienced developers and QA professionals
 



 Opportunity to improve testing strategy and quality processes
 



 Career growth opportunities in QA, Test Automation, and Software Quality Engineering
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  





 100% Remote Work
 



 Flexible Working Hours
 



 Competitive Salary Package
 



 Learning \& Professional Development Opportunities
 



 Technical Mentorship and Guidance
 



 Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment
 



 Career Growth Opportunities
 



 Exposure to Modern Testing Tools and Technologies
 



 Opportunity to Work on Real\-World Software Projects

description:
**About Amgen**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled, hands\-on Senior Associate QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, Veeva CRM application testing, mobile/iPad testing, API and integration testing, data validation, and AI\-enabled quality engineering.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing scalable automation solutions across complex enterprise applications, CRM platforms, mobile applications, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in increasing automation coverage, reducing manual regression effort, accelerating release validation, and improving overall product quality. The engineer will also leverage AI\-assisted testing capabilities to improve test design, automation development, test\-data generation, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on technical capability along with ownership of QA processes including test strategy, test planning, automation framework development, defect management, regression testing, and continuous quality improvement.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Developers, QA, Product, Data Engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define and implement end\-to\-end test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data, traceability, regression planning, release validation, and quality improvements across CRM Salesforce/Veeva, mobile/iPad, API, integration, data validation, and data migration scenarios.
* Perform manual and automated validation of data pipelines across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, including source\-to\-target mapping, transformation logic, business\-rule verification, schema checks, record\-count reconciliation, null/duplicate checks, referential integrity, thresholds, anomaly detection, ingestion, transformation, delivery, consumption, and migration\-quality validation.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute reusable automation frameworks, automated regression suites, and data\-validation scripts using tools and technologies such as Selenium, Copado Robotic Testing, COFTA, Microsoft Playwright, PyTest, Postman/Newman, Python, PySpark, and equivalent frameworks for CRM, web, mobile/iPad, API, integration, batch, real\-time, and data testing.
* Build and enhance reusable automation components for schema validation, data reconciliation, anomaly detection, lineage\-based validation, metadata/configuration\-driven testing, test\-data generation, mocks, stubs, automation utilities, and migration\-quality checks.
* Automate API and integration testing across middleware, CRM, cloud platforms, data platforms, and upstream/downstream systems, covering request/response validation, authentication, payloads, business rules, error handling, negative scenarios, retries, and batch or real\-time integration failures.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, support automated quality gates, enable shift\-left testing, and improve release readiness through smoke, sanity, functional, API, mobile, integration, data, and regression validation.
* Track, manage, and report defects using JIRA and related tools, ensuring clear documentation, root\-cause analysis, timely resolution, retesting, quality reporting, QA metrics, internal dashboards, and continuous improvement of QA processes and culture across Agile/SAFe delivery cycles.
* Leverage Generative AI and AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate test\-case creation, automation development, code review, test\-data generation, defect triage, log analysis, documentation, coverage\-gap identification, and automation\-maintenance insights while ensuring AI\-generated artifacts and engineering outputs are reviewed, traceable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise quality, privacy, governance, and responsible\-use expectations.


**Basic Qualifications \& Experience**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related discipline with 1–3 years of relevant experience, OR
* Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience, OR
* Diploma with 7–9 years of relevant experience.
* Relevant experience should include hands\-on QA automation across enterprise applications, CRM, APIs, integrations, mobile applications and/or data platforms.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**FUNCTIONAL / TECHNICAL SKILLS**
* Experience in testing automation in front end portals, Mobile iOS applications, .Net Framework and data pipelines.
* Practical experience with manual validation of data pipelines and source\-to\-target testing.
* Familiarity with data integration tools and platforms such as Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, Veeva/Salesforce,
* Strong understanding of test planning, defect tracking, bug lifecycle management, and QA documentation.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with standard QA processes.
* Knowledge of test case and defect management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr).
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, test case design, and defect lifecycle management.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in SQL, Python, and PySpark for testing and automating validation.
* Proven experience in manual and automated testing of batch and real\-time data pipelines.
* Familiarity with data processing and analytics stacks: Databricks, Spark, AWS (Glue, S3, Athena, Redshift).
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr.
* Ability to troubleshoot data issues independently and collaborate with engineering for root cause analysis.
* Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
* Experience validating data from various file formats such as JSON, CSV, Parquet, and Avro
* Strong ability to validate and automate data quality checks: schema validation, null checks, duplicates, thresholds, and transformation validation
* Hands\-on experience with API testing using Postman, pytest, or custom automation scripts
* AI\-enabled quality engineering: Practical experience using Generative AI or AI\-assisted development/testing tools for test generation, automation development, test\-data generation, defect analysis, documentation, prompt refinement, and validation of AI\-generated outputs.
* Responsible AI use: Awareness of enterprise AI security, privacy, governance, and responsible\-use considerations when applying AI to QA and software engineering activities.


**Good\-to\-have Skills**
* Experience with testing tools such as Selenium, Copado Robotic Testing, COFTA and other tools
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and data integration concepts
* Knowledge of AnyPoint Platform, Python, Java, Databricks, Veeva/Salesforce Platform, AWS cloud data platforms
* Experience evaluating or implementing AI\-powered testing/automation solutions
* Experience with large\-scale application or data migration testing.
* Experience developing QA dashboards and quality engineering metrics.
* Experience creating reusable test\-data generators, mocks, stubs, and automation utilities.


**PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS**
 Preferred:
   

  

* Salesforce/Veeva CRM platform certification
* AWS Associate/Professional certification


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong automation\-first and continuous\-improvement mindset.
* Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into effective automated test scenarios.
* Strong ownership and accountability for quality across the delivery lifecycle.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Curiosity and willingness to evaluate emerging technologies, particularly AI and intelligent automation, and translate them into practical improvements in software quality.

description:
Job Description – App Tester / Bug Testing Executive

**Company/App:** ZoraMeeto  
**Position:** App Tester / Bug Testing Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Part\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Remote / Work From Home  
**Experience:** Fresher \& Experienced Both Can Apply

Job Summary

We are looking for responsible and detail\-oriented individuals to help us **test the App, identify bugs, report technical issues, and provide user feedback**.

The selected candidate will use the app regularly, test different features and user flows, identify any errors or issues, and communicate with **2–4 users every day** to understand their experience and collect feedback.

Key Responsibilities

* Regularly use and test the App.
* Test different features, screens, buttons, registration/login processes, profiles, chat, notifications, and other app functions.
* Identify bugs, errors, crashes, broken links, UI/UX issues, and unexpected behavior.
* Record and report bugs with proper details, screenshots, screen recordings, or other relevant information.
* Test the app on different devices and internet conditions wherever possible.
* Communicate with **2–4 users daily** and guide them through basic app testing.
* Collect feedback from users regarding their experience, usability, and difficulties.
* Report user feedback and recurring issues to the concerned team.
* Re\-test bugs after they have been fixed and confirm whether the issue has been resolved.
* Maintain a daily testing and activity report.
* Maintain confidentiality of app\-related information and user data.

Daily Activities

The candidate will generally be expected to:

**1\. App Testing:**  
Test the assigned features and identify bugs or usability problems.

**2\. User Interaction:**  
Speak with **2–4 users per day** to help them test the application and collect genuine feedback.

**3\. Bug Reporting:**  
Document issues clearly with steps to reproduce, screenshots/videos, device details, and expected vs. actual results.

**4\. Feedback Reporting:**  
Share user suggestions, complaints, and improvement points with the team.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of mobile applications.
* Good observation and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills.
* Ability to clearly explain and report problems.
* Comfortable speaking with 2–4 people daily.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones and internet applications.
* Ability to maintain daily reports.
* Patient and responsible approach toward testing.
* Knowledge of bug\-reporting tools will be an advantage.

Eligibility

* 12th Pass / Graduate.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Candidates with experience in **App Testing, QA, Customer Support, Telecalling, User Testing, or Technical Support** will be preferred.
* Must have an Android/iOS smartphone and a stable internet connection.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

* Number of app features tested.
* Quality and accuracy of bug reports.
* Number of users contacted/tested daily.
* Quality of user feedback collected.
* Timely submission of testing reports.
* Successful verification of resolved bugs.

Important Note

This role is **not limited to telecalling**. The primary responsibility is **app testing and bug identification**, while daily interaction with 2–4 users is required for real\-user testing and feedback collection.

**If you are observant, comfortable using mobile apps, and enjoy finding problems and helping improve products, this role is a good opportunity for you.**

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

* Work from home
