title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
**Xplore New Technologies Private Limited is a technology development company focused on building innovative digital platforms and technology\-driven products.**

We develop online solutions that connect businesses, property owners, service providers, and customers through technology.

Our flagship product, **SpotLet**, is an online marketplace and digital platform designed to help property owners showcase, promote, and generate income from their properties while making it easier for customers to discover and book unique spaces.

We are currently building our **Business Development team** to promote and expand SpotLet by connecting with property owners and bringing quality properties onto the platform.

**About SpotLet**

**SpotLet is an online marketplace and platform that provides information, discovery, and booking opportunities for properties and unique spaces across multiple categories.**

Property owners can use SpotLet to **showcase their properties online and create opportunities to generate additional income** by making their spaces available for relevant bookings.

The platform can feature a wide variety of properties, including homes, villas, cottages, farmhouses, apartments, event spaces, unique venues, and other properties suitable for stays, events, and creative productions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target\-oriented **Business Development Associates (BDAs)** to join our growing team in Hyderabad.

As a BDA, your primary responsibility will be to **promote SpotLet to property owners and onboard suitable properties onto the platform.**

You will primarily work through **phone calls and other digital communication channels** to identify property owners, introduce SpotLet, explain how the platform works, and demonstrate how listing their property can help them reach potential customers and generate additional income.

This is primarily an **Inside Sales / Business Development / Property Acquisition role**.

You will speak directly with property owners, understand their properties and requirements, explain the different opportunities available through SpotLet, and encourage them to list their properties on the platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to prospective property owners.
* Introduce and promote **SpotLet** to property owners.
* Clearly explain SpotLet's online marketplace and how it works.
* Explain the potential benefits of listing properties on SpotLet.
* Identify properties suitable for Homestays, Staycations, Events, Film Shoots, Photography, and other creative requirements.
* Understand the property type, location, facilities, features, and potential use cases.
* Persuade interested property owners to list their properties on SpotLet.
* Follow up with prospective property owners and convert leads into successful property listings.
* Assist property owners through the initial onboarding and listing process.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with property owners.
* Coordinate with internal teams for successful property onboarding.
* Achieve individual and team\-based business development targets.
* Collect feedback from property owners and share insights with the team to improve SpotLet's products, services, and sales process.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for candidates who are:

* Confident and comfortable speaking with people over the phone.
* Good at communicating and explaining products/services clearly.
* Persuasive, energetic, and customer\-focused.
* Comfortable with outbound calling and sales conversations.
* Comfortable working with targets and performance goals.
* Good at follow\-ups and relationship building.
* Self\-motivated and willing to learn.
* Comfortable using computers, smartphones, WhatsApp, email, CRM systems, and basic office software.
* Interested in technology, digital platforms, online marketplaces, sales, and business development.
* Able to communicate effectively in **English and Hindi**.
* Knowledge of Other Languages is an advantage.

**Freshers Are Welcome**

**Freshers with good communication skills, confidence, enthusiasm, and an interest in technology and sales are encouraged to apply.**

You do not need prior experience in real estate, hospitality, or property management.

We will provide training on:

* SpotLet and its platform
* Product features and services
* Property\-owner acquisition
* Sales and communication
* Lead management and follow\-ups
* Property onboarding process

What matters most is your **communication ability, confidence, willingness to learn, and ability to build relationships with property owners.**

Why Join Xplore New Technologies \& SpotLet?

* Work with a **technology development company** building digital products and platforms.
* Be part of the team responsible for promoting and growing our **flagship product, SpotLet**.
* Gain hands\-on experience in **technology, online marketplaces, inside sales, business development, and customer acquisition**.
* Work across multiple industries including **hospitality, real estate, events, media, entertainment, and creative production**.
* Learn how a technology platform is marketed, scaled, and expanded into new markets.
* Opportunity to develop strong skills in communication, sales, negotiation, relationship management, and digital business.
* Performance\-based incentives in addition to fixed compensation.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance and contribution.

Key Skills

**Business Development \| Inside Sales \| Sales \| Telecalling \| Outbound Calling \| Lead Generation \| Property Acquisition \| Customer Acquisition \| Online Marketplace \| Technology Products \| Relationship Management \| Negotiation \| Communication \| Follow\-up \| CRM**

Compensation

**Fixed Salary \+ Performance\-Based Incentives**

Compensation will be based on the candidate's experience, communication skills, and suitability for the role.

Career Growth

High\-performing candidates can progress through a structured career path:

**Business Development Associate → Senior BDA → Team Leader → Business Development Manager**

As SpotLet expands into new cities and markets, there will be opportunities for high\-performing team members to take on greater responsibilities in **city expansion, team management, business development, and marketplace growth.**

Join the SpotLet Growth Team

If you are confident, ambitious, enjoy speaking with people, and want to build a career in **technology, sales, and business development**, this is an opportunity to become part of a growing technology company and contribute directly to the growth of its flagship product.

As a **Business Development Associate**, you will play an important role in expanding SpotLet's property network by helping property owners discover new ways to showcase and generate income from their properties.

**Join Xplore New Technologies Private Limited and be part of the team building and growing SpotLet – an online marketplace connecting properties and unique spaces with customers looking for stays, events, and creative production locations.**

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Healthy Jeena Sikho is one of North India's fastest\-growing home healthcare companies, specializing in the rental and sale of medical equipment such as BiPAP/CPAP machines, oxygen concentrators, wheelchairs, hospital beds, patient care products, and rehabilitation equipment.

Human Resources

Full\-Time

1–3 years in HR / Generalist role (freshers with strong HR internship experience may also apply)

As per industry standards / experience (to be discussed)

Role Overview

Healthy Jeena Sikho is looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Executive to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, including hiring, attendance, payroll support, employee records, and general people management. This role is central to keeping the HR function organised and ensuring a smooth employee experience across all locations.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Hiring

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, and coordinating with hiring managers.
* Post job openings on job portals (Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn), social media, and other channels.
* Conduct initial telephonic/HR screening rounds and shortlist candidates.
* Coordinate offer letters, joining formalities, and pre\-onboarding documentation.
* Maintain and update the recruitment tracker/MIS with candidate status.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for frequently hired roles.

Onboarding \& Employee Records

* Conduct induction and onboarding for new joiners, including documentation and ID/access setup.
* Maintain and update employee master data, personal files, and HR databases (physical and digital).
* Issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, and experience/relieving letters.
* Ensure all employee documentation is complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor daily attendance, biometric/attendance system logs, and resolve discrepancies.
* Track leaves, half\-days, late\-marks, and maintain accurate leave balances for all employees.
* Coordinate with department heads/managers on attendance\-related issues and irregularities.
* Prepare monthly attendance and leave reports for payroll processing.

Payroll Support

* Collate and verify attendance, leave, and incentive data for accurate monthly payroll input.
* Coordinate with finance/accounts team for salary processing, reimbursements, and full \& final settlements.
* Assist employees with payroll\-related queries (salary slips, PF, ESIC, TDS, deductions, etc.).
* Support statutory compliance activities such as PF, ESIC, and other applicable labour law filings.

Day\-to\-Day HR Operations

* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and general HR support.
* Support performance review cycles, appraisal documentation, and tracking.
* Assist in drafting and implementing HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbooks.
* Coordinate employee engagement activities, events, and internal communications.
* Handle exit formalities including resignation processing, exit interviews, and clearance coordination.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable labour laws across all locations.
* Prepare routine HR reports and MIS (headcount, attrition, hiring status, etc.) for management review.

Skills \& Qualifications

* Graduate/Postgraduate in HR, Business Administration, or a related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
* 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in HR operations, recruitment, attendance, and payroll support.
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with HRMS or payroll software is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of labour laws, PF, ESIC, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
* Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.

**About Pearson** 



  

  


 Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through learning. Founded in 1844, we deliver digital\-first, accessible learning experiences and employ over 20,000 people globally. In India, we support learners and educators through innovative educational products, technology, and services.
 


  

  


 We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable workplace where every employee is valued and empowered to thrive.
 


  

  


**About the Apprenticeship Program** 



  

  


 Pearson India’s Apprenticeship Program provides graduates and early\-career professionals with structured training, hands\-on experience, and mentorship from industry experts. Through a blend of on\-the\-job learning and guided development, apprentices build the professional and technical skills needed to succeed in a global organization.
 


  

  


**About the Division** 



  

  


 The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives—budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager is part of the broader team that executes annual plans and organizes and prioritizes tasks and teams to ensure delivery.
 


  

  


**About the Role** 



  

  


 You will work with authors, Pearson Content and Digital Producers, Quality Assurance (QA), Accessibility, Rights and Permissions (R\&P) and vendor partners to deliver stable, high‐quality products to improve learner outcomes and maximize instructor impact. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early\-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content.
  

  
* Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery.
  

  
* Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series\-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format.
  

  
* Learn how to act as point\-person throughout entire lifecycle process, respond to queries from various stakeholders, serve as knowledge resource for Portfolio team.
  

  
* Learn how to provide high\-level management of a large number of primary authors, development editors, technical editors, supplement authors, copyeditors, and freelance project managers. Negotiate rates, prioritize work.
  

  
* Learn how to provide communication across cross\-functional teams. Includes initiating launch meetings, serving as meeting moderator, and maintaining status reports.a
  

  
* Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects
  

  
* Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays.
  

  
* Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns.
  

  
* Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance.
  

  
* Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation.
  

  
* Support in contributing to cover and internal design process.
  


  


**Desirable Skills and Attributes** 



  

  
* Highly flexible and adaptable, with a positive attitude when operating in an environment of continual flux.
  

  
* Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem\-solve on a daily basis.
  

  
* Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed.
  

  
* Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment.
  

  
* Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems.
  

  
* Communicates effectively (written and verbally) with peers, project team, and sponsors/stakeholders. Shows strong command of the English language.
  

  
* Able to assess and manage across a full project breadth and depth, ensuring a successful delivery of products.
  

  
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams delivering both digital and print product outputs.
  

  
* Diligent attention to detail.
  

  
* Strong organization skills: Self\-organizing and self\-motivating.
  

  
* Strong time\-management abilities\-\-organizing tasks in a logical and efficient manner allowing for multitasking and making appropriate calls on prioritization.
  


  


**Eligibility Criteria** 



  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
  

  
* Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply.
  

  
* Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal.
  

  
* Must be legally eligible to work in India.
  


  


**Experience You Will Gain** 



  

  
* Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting.
  

  
* Hands\-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication.
  

  
* Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets.
  

  
* Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created.
  

  
* Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R\&P teams in a professional business environment.
  


  


**Work Schedule** 



  

  


 This is a full\-time apprenticeship from Monday to Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. The role involves working across several geographies and requires occasional flexibility in supporting the business beyond regular office hours.
 


  

  


**Benefits and Rewards** 



  

  
* Competitive stipend
  

  
* Professional development and mentorship
  

  
* Paid time off as per company policy
  

  
* Personal Accident Insurance Coverage
  


  


 Access to Pearson’s learning platforms and online courses
 


  

  
* Exposure to global work culture and career pathways
  


  


**Location** 



  

  


 This role will be based at Pearson's office in Noida.
 


  

  


**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** 



  

  


 Pearson India is committed to building an inclusive environment that embraces diverse perspectives and backgrounds. We value equality, respect, and belonging, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to contribute and grow.
 


  

  


**Application Closing Date:** 



  

  


 This position is offered under the Apprentices Act, 1961, as part of an official Apprenticeship Program. As an apprentice, you will undergo structured on\-the\-job training, combined with theoretical learning where applicable, to develop specific skills and prepare for skilled employment.
 


  

  


**Who we are:** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

**Software Engineer – Corporate Affairs Digital Platforms**
**Role Profile / Job Description**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting high\-quality digital platform capabilities across Corporate Affairs digital products and services. The role contributes to secure, scalable and maintainable solutions that support global web, content, brand, campaign and operational support capabilities.
   

  

 Working with Technical Delivery Leads, Product Managers, architects, QA, operations and supplier teams, the role turns prioritised requirements into reliable software. It follows modern engineering practices across coding, testing, automation, DevOps, observability and operational support, helping ensure platforms remain resilient, secure, efficient and easy to evolve.
   

  

 Scope \& Scale
   

  

**Area**
**Scope**
**Platform focus**
 Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics and operational support capabilities.
   

  

**Engineering scope**
 Builds and supports front\-end, back\-end, integration, automation, testing and DevOps capabilities depending on platform needs and team structure.
   

  

**Delivery model**
 Works within Agile delivery teams, contributing to refinement, estimation, development, testing, release and operational improvement activities.
   

  

**Operational ownership**
 Supports a “you build it, you run it” mindset through monitoring, observability, incident support, problem solving and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Quality focus**
 Contributes to secure, accessible, performant, maintainable and production\-ready software aligned to engineering standards and platform governance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Software Design \& Development
   

  

* Design, build and maintain digital platform capabilities, components, services, APIs, integrations and automation solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure and well\-tested code aligned to agreed engineering standards and coding practices.
* Contribute to technical design, solution options, code reviews and implementation feasibility assessments.
* Support platform modernisation, re\-use of shared patterns, reduction of technical debt and simplification of legacy capabilities.
* Develop solutions that are scalable, accessible, performant and supportable across global and multi\-market use cases.


 Agile Delivery \& Product Contribution
   

  

* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, demos, retrospectives and delivery reviews.
* Work with Product Managers and Technical Delivery Leads to understand business outcomes, user needs and prioritised requirements.
* Break down technical work into clear tasks and contribute to user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery planning.
* Identify assumptions, dependencies, blockers and risks early, increasing with options and recommendations where needed.
* Contribute to delivery transparency through clear updates, documentation and use of delivery management tools.


 Testing, Quality \& Release Engineering
   

  

* Build and maintain unit, integration, component and automated tests to support reliable software delivery.
* Support regression testing, accessibility checks, performance validation and production readiness activities.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment processes and environment management.
* Perform code reviews and use static analysis, quality gates and peer feedback to improve engineering quality.
* Support safe release practices, rollback planning and post\-release verification.


 Platform Operations \& DevOps
   

  

* Support operational reliability through monitoring, observability, logging, alerting and service health improvements.
* Investigate and resolve incidents, defects and platform issues, working with support, supplier and infrastructure teams as required.
* Contribute to runbooks, knowledge articles, support documentation and handover materials.
* Support automation of manual operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce risk and increase delivery speed.
* Help ensure services meet non\-functional requirements for resilience, availability, security, privacy and maintainability.


 Collaboration \& Engineering Culture
   

  

* Collaborate effectively with architects, QA, operations, security, privacy, analytics, suppliers and business customers.
* Share knowledge, document solutions and support capability building across bp and supplier engineering teams.
* Apply a product attitude by considering user value, business impact, long\-term operability and platform consistency.
* Adopt AI\-assisted engineering and automation tools where appropriate and governed, improving productivity and quality.
* Promote continuous improvement, curiosity, engineering field and accountability across the team.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Experience building and supporting digital products, web platforms, CMS\-backed services, APIs, integrations or cloud\-native applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, testing, maintainability, design patterns, security and performance awareness.
* Experience with modern development practices, Agile delivery, version control, CI/CD, automated testing and DevOps ways of working.
* Ability to work with requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, translating business needs into robust technical outcomes.
* Good understanding of operational readiness, monitoring, logging, incident support and production service ownership.
* Experience working with suppliers, distributed teams and cross\-functional stakeholders in enterprise technology environments.
* Desirable experience with Contentful, MACH architecture, headless CMS, React or modern front\-end frameworks, Java/API development, AWS, Azure DevOps, Git, automation or AI\-assisted development.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Delivery of high\-quality software changes, fixes and enhancements to agreed scope, quality and timeline expectations.
* Clean, maintainable and secure code with appropriate test coverage, documentation and peer review.
* Improved platform reliability, performance, accessibility, security and operational supportability.
* Effective contribution to Agile ceremonies, estimates, refinement, release activity and delivery transparency.
* Reduction of manual effort, technical debt and operational risk through automation, simplification and engineering improvements.
* Strong collaboration with product, delivery, architecture, QA, operations and supplier teams.
* Successful transition of changes into production and BAU support with clear ownership and support documentation.

title: Design, Brand & User Experience Associate
description:
AI\-native products need AI\-native design thinking. We’re looking for someone who can see around the corner of what “simple” means in a world where the interface itself is starting to think.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Understand and design for customer journeys across our emerging AI\-native applications.
* Simplify complex advertising and automation workflows into genuinely usable experiences.
* Shape brand and visual identity consistent with the design system across web, product, and communications.
* Push a point of view on where AI\-native product design is headed — and design for that future, not just today.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Strong UX/UI fundamentals and a portfolio that shows real problem\-solving, not just visual polish.
* Demonstrated interest in AI\-native applications, AI automation, and their implications for design.
* A visionary streak — you can articulate where the industry is going and design toward it.
* Excellent communication and the ability to defend design decisions with reasoning, not just taste.


**Bonus Points:** 
*Prior exposure to programmatic advertising, AI tooling, or interaction design for automation\-heavy products.*
 For all positions: we’re looking for people who learn quickly, adapt to new and emerging technologies, and want to help build the future of advertising technology. This is an office\-based role in South Delhi — we value genuine enthusiasm for working from office, tinkering with LLMs, AI, programmatic, ad insertion, and even gaming, inside a startup\-style, operationally flexible environment. Hard work and a real focus on building a long\-term career in ad\-tech software development matter more to us than a polished résumé.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*
 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.
   

  

 Application Requirements
   

  

* A completed application form, including your resume.
* Essay 1 — Statement of Purpose: why Blowtrumpet is for you, why you want to be part of ad\-tech, and how ad\-tech differs from other industries (e.g. ed\-tech) in ways that interest you.
* Essay 2 — Your Workflow in the Emerging Technologies Age: your view on AI and where it’s heading, how you’re incorporating AI into your workflow today, and real examples of difficulties you’ve faced and how you resolved them.
* Essay 3 — Gamification: what gamification means to you, a real\-life example, what the gamification loop looks like, and how you’d apply it to create an engaging experience for friends, family, or coworkers.


 You may use AI tools to help write these essays.
 **If you do, disclose which tools you used, your prompts and guidance, and confirm your agreement with the output. If you choose not to use AI, tell us that too.**
 Optional Guiding Questions
   

  

 You’re welcome to draw on any of the following while writing your three essays — they’re prompts, not a separate form to fill out line by line.
   

  

* 1\. Provide us with your present PIN Code. We won’t be processing applications without a valid PIN Code and address location. You’re encouraged to join our Discord server, “Hire For Work” (linked in the website footer) — introduce yourself and interact there; it goes a long way for our assessment and lets us connect with you in real time. Also define, in your own words, the difference between ed\-tech and ad\-tech.
* 2\. Name 5 ed\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you? What skills have you developed through ed\-tech?
* 3\. Name 5 ad\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you?
* 4\. Why is ad\-tech for you?
* 5\. Why do you want to work with a startup? Talk about one area of expertise you feel will add value to our products, and the clients or industry it serves.
* 6\. We also hire for our legacy services business. Would you like your application considered for a client\-facing, incentive/ROI\-driven role in advertising services? How would you add value to that practice, which role would you prefer for your career progression, and for which clients or sector?
* 7\. Why do you use AI? How do you envision AI being used in the years to come? Talk about a recent development in AI — is it close to the ad\-tech or fin\-tech industries?
* 8\. Do you feel knowledge of fin\-tech systems is useful for product development in ad\-tech? What are the advantages of AI in building or managing a fin\-tech environment?
* 9\. How do you keep up with the latest innovations? Name 5 websites you consult for staying updated, learning new skills, or troubleshooting.
* 10\. Describe your troubleshooting workflow.
* 11\. Are you a gamer? Which games have you played? How often, when, and with what objective?
* 12\. Are you a streamer / content creator? What software and platforms do you use? Share your channel details and your content development/management workflow.
* 13\. What do you understand by gamification? Create a sample gamification loop for an ad\-tech environment that you feel would be useful for the industry — mention the checkpoints, endpoints, rewards, and your approach to quantifying them.
* 14\. Share a real\-world example of gamification you’ve practiced with friends, family, or coworkers.
* 15\. Write a clear statement of purpose to complete your application. How does Blowtrumpet fit with your aspirations, and what would you like to achieve? Discuss your plans for the next 3–5 years.


 Status \& Contact
   

  

 We make a sincere effort to respond early to fully completed applications. Because of application volume, we’re sometimes only able to respond to shortlisted candidates. You can check on your application status by writing to hr@blowtrumpet.com.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We're currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 As we've grown, we've realised that great HR Operations isn't about maintaining spreadsheets or chasing paperwork. It's about creating an experience where people can do the best work of their careers without having to worry about everything happening behind the scenes.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who's excited to build that experience with us. This role is for someone who's organised without being rigid, dependable, and enjoys creating structure behind the scenes so the rest of the team can move faster. You'll work closely with our People team to ensure our HR processes run smoothly as we continue to scale.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Own
 **HR operations** 
 across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, documentation, HRIS management and employee records.
* Ensure all HR processes, policies and documentation are accurate, compliant and completed on time.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, making sure every employee has a smooth and thoughtful experience from day one to their last day.
* Support payroll, leave management, insurance and other people operations by coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
* Help manage employee letters, contracts, background verification and other HR documentation.
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to ensure a seamless transition from candidate to employee.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing HR processes through better systems, automation and documentation as we continue to grow.



  





**What makes you a good fit**




  




* You genuinely enjoy bringing
 **structure to chaos** 
 and get satisfaction from making processes run effortlessly.
* You're highly organised, detail\-oriented and rarely let things fall through the cracks.
* You handle confidential information with discretion and understand that trust is earned through consistency.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities and know how to stay calm when things get busy.
* You have strong communication skills and enjoy working with people across different teams and levels.
* You're someone who takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs fixing.
* Experience with HRMS tools, payroll coordination or employee documentation will be a plus, but curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**




  





 Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture \- but it ends up becoming more than just that.
 



  





 It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.
 



  





**Our Purpose**




  





 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
 



  





**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-** 




  




* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together



  





**Our Values**




  





 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
 



  





**We have 5 core values:\-** 



* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously



  





**Perks \& Benefits**




  





 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-
 



  




* **Health Insurance \-** 
 Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* **Quarterly Off\-sites \-** 
 Quarterly off\-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off\-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* **Cult Fitness Membership \-** 
 All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* **Personal Development \-** 
 We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance \-** 
 Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.



  





**How to apply?**




  





 If this sounds interesting drop a personal note with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
 **nikita@bitespeed.co** 
 \& cc
 **talent@bitespeed.co.** 




  





 Know someone who might be a great fit?
 **Refer them to us** 
 , if they end up joining we'll send you an
 **Apple Airpods Pro** 
 as a gesture of thanks!
 



  





 For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Title \- HR Manager** 




**No of positions: 1** 




**Industry: Internet/Web Software** 




**Employment Type: Full Time** 




**Location: Noida (Work from Office) \- Six days' week** 




  





**Role Overview:**




 The HR Manager at SiteRecon will serve as both a strategic partner and an operational leader for our People function. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role suited for someone who has grown through the HR ranks and is ready to run an entire HR function independently at a fast\-moving startup.
 



  





 You will lead the HR team, manage end\-to\-end HR operations, and be the driving force behind implementing and scaling our HRMS. You will work directly with the founders and leadership team to build the people infrastructure that will take SiteRecon from its current stage to the next level of growth.
 



  





 This is not a policy\-maintenance role. We want someone who can build systems, automate manual work, challenge the status quo, and make HR a competitive advantage for the business. Above all, you will be the primary custodian of SiteRecon's culture — ensuring our values are lived and experienced at every level, every day.
 



  





**About Siterecon:**




 SiteRecon is helping property maintenance contractors in the US to automate property mapping and site visits through our mapping platform, giving back time, speeding up their sales process, and increasing their profitability. We are building the next\-generation property intelligence platform and looking for people to help out on our mission to revolutionize how businesses make decisions in North America.
 



  





**About the Team:** 




 Started by IIT Delhi alumni who have worked with multinationals in satellite imaging, e\-commerce, and edtech sectors.
 



 To learn more about the team \& our origin story \- https://order.siterecon.ai/about\-us
 



 To learn more about what we do for our customers \- https://order.siterecon.ai
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Company Culture \& Employee Experience** 



* Champion and uphold the company's values and culture across all levels — ensuring they are consistently demonstrated in day\-to\-day interactions, not just written on a wall.
* Act as the primary custodian of organizational culture by fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performance work environment.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives that strengthen team morale, trust, and sense of belonging across the organization.
* Ensure every stage of the employee lifecycle — from onboarding to exit — reflects and reinforces the company's culture and values.
* Monitor employee sentiment through structured feedback mechanisms; recommend and implement initiatives to improve workplace experience and retention.



  





**HR Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Collaborate directly with the CEO and leadership team to design and execute a people strategy aligned with SiteRecon's business objectives and growth trajectory.
* Lead, mentor, and assess the performance of the HR team (team of 3\), setting clear goals and holding the team accountable.
* Build and refine HR policies, frameworks, and processes from scratch or improve existing ones to match scale.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and employment regulations at all times.



  





**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Management** 



* Own the full\-cycle recruitment process — from defining hiring requirements with managers to offer roll\-out and onboarding.
* Build scalable hiring pipelines for both tech and operations roles, managing different profiles from software engineers to operations staff.
* Develop and manage onboarding frameworks that get new hires productive and culturally integrated quickly.
* Lead exit processes with structured offboarding and capture insights through exit interviews to reduce attrition.
* Develop workforce plans to support operational peaks and business scaling needs.



  





**HRMS Implementation \& Process Automation** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of SiteRecon's HRMS — own requirements gathering, workflow design, developer feedback loops, UAT, and go\-live.
* Translate HR processes into clear functional requirements for the development team building on the HRMS.
* Drive HRMS adoption across the HR team and the wider organization, reducing dependency on manual, spreadsheet\-based workflows.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR tasks (attendance, payroll inputs, leave management, appraisals) and execute on them.
* Act as the internal product owner for all HR technology — evaluate tools, champion adoption, and continuously improve digital workflows.



  





**HR Operations \& Employee Relations** 



* Oversee all day\-to\-day HR operations — payroll coordination, attendance, compliance, documentation, and employee records.
* Foster a strong employee relations culture by being accessible, fair, and consistent in handling grievances, disputes, and disciplinary matters.
* Act as a bridge between the operations/shop\-floor teams and senior management to build trust and transparent communication.
* Ensure clear and timely communication of company policies, expectations, and any organizational changes.
* Mediate conflicts with a balanced and constructive approach.
* Conduct periodic reviews of HR policies to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness; proactively identify gaps and design improved policies where needed.
* Ensure timely rollout and company\-wide implementation of all policy changes.



  





**Performance Management** 



* Design and implement a robust performance management framework — goal setting, mid\-year check\-ins, appraisals, and feedback cycles.
* Drive company\-wide adoption of the performance framework; ensure consistent implementation across all functions, not just on paper.
* Hold managers accountable to review timelines — track completion rates and escalate delays to leadership.
* Champion merit\-based appraisal outcomes — compensation and rewards anchored to demonstrated impact and performance, not tenure or seniority.
* Work with managers to define meaningful KPIs for their teams and ensure consistent implementation.
* Identify skill gaps and underperformance early; support managers with coaching, PIP design, and structured interventions.
* Champion a culture of continuous feedback and accountability across the organization.



  





**Learning \& Development** 



* Assess training needs across teams and design L\&D programs that address skill gaps and build leadership capability.
* Drive a culture of continuous learning — encourage participation in development programs and track their business impact.
* Partner with functional leads to create role\-specific onboarding and upskilling programs for operations and tech teams.



  





**HR Metrics \& Reporting** 



* Own HR analytics and reporting — provide leadership with regular, data\-driven insights on headcount, attrition, hiring velocity, engagement, and performance.
* Use data to proactively identify people risks and recommend corrective actions before they become problems.
* Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership real\-time visibility into people metrics.



  





**Qualifications:**




**Education** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
* Advanced certifications such as SHRM\-CP/SHRM\-SCP, PHR/SPHR, or equivalent are a plus.



  





**Experience (All Required)** 



* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful exposure across the full HR spectrum — recruitment, operations, compliance, employee relations, and performance management.
* At least 2–3 years in a role where you led or significantly influenced HR strategy, not just executed it.
* Demonstrated experience leading or managing a small HR team.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or configuring an HRMS — including requirements gathering, working with developers, conducting UAT, and driving adoption.
* Experience in a startup, high\-growth tech company, or operations\-heavy business strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to managing a digital\-factory or operations\-floor workforce (blue\-collar or semi\-technical teams) is an advantage.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Proficiency in HRIS/HRMS platforms and HR analytics tools.
* Ability to translate HR process requirements into functional specs for engineering or product teams.
* Solid understanding of Indian labor laws, workplace compliance, and statutory requirements.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for HR reporting; exposure to data visualization tools is a plus.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Ownership mindset — you treat HR like your own business unit and hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not just activities.
* Strong communication skills in both English and Hindi (written and verbal).
* Strategic thinking with the ability to zoom out and see the big picture, while also executing day\-to\-day operations without dropping the ball.
* Influencing without authority — able to drive behavioral change across the organization even without a large team.
* Analytical and data\-driven approach to identifying problems and making recommendations.
* High adaptability and comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong conflict resolution and mediation skills.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior experience in a product\-led or SaaS company.
* Expertise in change management and driving organizational behavior shifts.
* Experience designing and delivering both technical and behavioral training programs.
* Familiarity with remote or distributed workforce management.



  





**Perks of Working at SiteRecon** 



* Work ownership — if you see something that adds value, you have the freedom to own and execute it.
* Minimum opacity between you and leadership. Work directly with the founders of a fast\-growing company.
* Direct communication with key stakeholders — get real\-time insights and feedback on your work.
* Freedom to speak up, challenge the status quo, and suggest meaningful improvements.
* Full visibility into the operational side of the business — understand the bigger picture and see how your HR work directly impacts company outcomes

+ Facilitate onboarding by introducing new hires to hotel policies, culture, and service standards.

* Training \& Development
+ Organize training sessions, safety, and hospitality standards.
+ Identify skill gaps and implement development programs to enhance staff performance.

* Employee Relations
+ Promote employee engagement and satisfaction through recognition programs and feedback systems.

* Compliance \& Policy Management
+ Ensure adherence to labor laws, health and safety regulations, and hotel policies.
+ Maintain accurate employee records and handle disciplinary procedures when necessary.

* Performance Management
+ Support managers in conducting appraisals and setting performance goals.
+ Monitor productivity and recommend improvements to align with hotel objectives.


**Qualifications**
**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Essential Skills
+ Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
+ Knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.
+ Organizational ability to manage multiple HR functions simultaneously.

* Preferred Qualifications
+ Degree in Human Resources, Hospitality Management, or Business Administration.
+ Prior experience in hospitality or service\-oriented industries.

title: Executive/ Senior Executive - HR & Admin
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 Are you a HR professional looking to grow your career with a global leader in automation technology and software? Emerson offers an exciting opportunity for an
 **Executive/Senior Executive \- General Administration \& HR** 
 . This role entails aligning HR practices with the business needs of the manufacturing unit, supporting end\-to\-end processes, and encouraging a positive work culture. This role will also collaborate with Mahindra World City (MWC Site) HR team to maintain compliance with labor laws and company policies while promoting employee engagement, development, and well\-being.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Coordinate leadership visits and manage all aspects of site administration, ensuring executive engagements and site operations run seamlessly.
* Oversee facilities administration while delivering comprehensive employee support services, including workplace safety, infrastructure readiness, and employee welfare.
* Manage vendor relationships and administer the contract workforce, ensuring compliance with company policies and smooth vendor operations.
* Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date employee documentation while providing consistent administrative support for HR and operational needs.
* Support talent acquisition activities and manage employee lifecycle processes, from onboarding to exit formalities, ensuring a positive employee experience.
* Administer learning initiatives and performance management programs, including training coordination, appraisal cycles, and skill development activities.
* Drive employee engagement programs and facilitate effective communication support, fostering a collaborative and motivated workplace culture.
* Handle payroll operations, monitor attendance systems, and provide support for HCM platforms, ensuring accuracy and compliance in workforce data
* Check and verify all administrative invoices to ensure accuracy before processing them for payment.
* Serve as the admin coordinator with FCV BU (stationed at MWC PRM) to ensure seamless execution of facilities and employee support requirements across the site.


**Who You Are:**
 You model collaboration across the organization, you facilitate breakthroughs by integrating diverse views and finding common ground or acceptable alternatives, attentive to placing a high priority on developing others.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Good understanding of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of labor laws and statutory compliance applicable to manufacturing organizations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information.
* Good organizational and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience working with HRMS and payroll systems.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to prepare and interpret HR reports.


**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**
* MSW/MBA with solid experience in Human resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a manufacturing or factory environment.
* Knowledge of employment laws, statutory compliance, and industrial relations.
* Experience in facilitating learning and development programs.
* Proficient in Tamil and English (knowledge of other regional languages is an added advantage).


 This role offers a great opportunity to make a tangible impact on the HR function of a leading manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate will be hands\-on, results\-oriented, and passionate about driving HR excellence in a factory setting.
   

  

**Our Culture \& Commitment to You**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
   

  

 We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
   

  

 We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
   

  

 At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

 Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
   

  

 With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

Join our team – let’s go!

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021, its ornamental gardens, tumbling fountains and stately Indo\-Saracenic architecture describing a love story between India and the West. Set on a 21\-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna, this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.
   

  

 Just 20 minutes from the airport, Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride, guided by migratory birds. Discover 137 rooms and suites, 10 dining experiences, two pools, wellness rituals, and the timeless care of the Raffles Butler.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Learning \& Development Manager to join our team in Udaipur, India. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster employee growth. Reporting to the Director of People \& Culture, you will collaborate with leadership teams across the organization to create a culture of continuous learning and professional development. This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative and empathetic professional to make a meaningful impact on our workforce's skills, engagement, and career progression.
   

  

* Design, develop, and facilitate a variety of training programs including onboarding, leadership development, skills enhancement, and specialized workshops to support organizational goals and employee development
* Execute a comprehensive onboarding experience for new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and strong foundation for success; continuously update and improve onboarding processes based on feedback and organizational needs
* Conduct thorough needs assessments in collaboration with department leaders to identify skill gaps and training requirements; translate findings into actionable learning strategies
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all training activities, participant information, and completion rates; analyze training data and metrics to measure program effectiveness and ROI
* Support the development and coaching of departmental trainers, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all training initiatives throughout the organization
* Oversee the administration of online learning management systems, including course assignments, progress monitoring, and completion tracking for mandatory and elective programs
* Partner with operational leaders to review job task checklists and training tools, ensuring they support effective departmental onboarding and skill development
* Collaborate with regional Learning \& Development counterparts to align strategic direction, share best practices, and maintain consistency across the organization
* Support apprenticeship programs and educational assistance initiatives, fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional growth
* Oversee the performance review program to ensure timely and thorough completion of probationary and annual reviews for all employees
* Contribute to broader People \& Culture operations and organizational initiatives as assigned; demonstrate flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business needs


**Qualifications**
 \*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*
   

  

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a leadership role, preferably within the hospitality, service, or corporate environment
* Proven experience in designing and facilitating training programs that drive measurable results and service excellence
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting needs assessments and translating organizational requirements into effective learning solutions
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Publisher, Excel, and Word)
* Proficiency with online learning management systems and training administration platforms
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop data\-driven improvement strategies
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to diverse audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships with colleagues at all organizational levels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Previous experience in Learning \& Development, talent management, or human resources functions
* University degree in Hotel/Restaurant Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
* Experience with budget management and financial planning for training programs
* Familiarity with change management practices and organizational development
* Coaching and mentoring experience
* Experience developing and delivering leadership development programs


**Key Competencies**
* Enthusiastic, positive, and motivational approach to employee development
* Detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and quality
* Innovative and creative mindset with willingness to explore new training methodologies
* Collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams
* Flexible and adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Results\-oriented with a commitment to achieving organizational goals
* Empathetic and supportive in fostering employee growth and engagement
* Inclusive mindset that values diverse perspectives and backgrounds
* Efficient and organized in managing time and resources effectively
* Visionary thinking with the ability to anticipate future organizational learning needs


 Additional Information
   

  

* An opportunity to be with world’s preferred hospitality company
* Captivating and rewarding experience working alongside passionate professionals
* Range of exclusive Heartist Benefits
* Develop your talent through learning programs by Academy Accor.

title: Pre-Sales Business Analyst
company: Pericent BPM And DMS Software (P) Limited
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pericent BPM And DMS Software (P) Limited is a Jaipur\-based enterprise software company specializing in document and business process management solutions. The company builds and maintains docEdge, a Document Management System, and bpmEdge, a Business Process Management System. Its products are trusted by enterprises in NBFC, Manufacturing, Healthcare, and Government sectors for document control, workflow automation, and regulatory compliance. Team members collaborate closely with clients to support digital transformation and efficient process management. Joining Pericent offers opportunities to work on scalable B2B software used across diverse, regulated industries.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Pre\-Sales Business Analyst role based in Jaipur. The Pre\-Sales Business Analyst collaborates with the sales team to understand client requirements, analyze business processes, and map customer needs to docEdge and bpmEdge capabilities. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting requirements discovery sessions, preparing solution proposals, creating process diagrams or use cases, and delivering product demonstrations tailored to client workflows. The role involves supporting RFP/RFI responses, documenting functional specifications, and coordinating with product and implementation teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible and aligned with product strategy. The analyst also gathers client feedback from pre\-sales engagements and helps refine product positioning and sales collateral.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Business Analytics capabilities to interpret client
 
 requirements
 
 , workflows, and documentation.
* Candidates should possess solid Business Analysis skills, including process mapping, requirement elicitation, and documentation of functional specifications.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to engage with stakeholders, present solutions, and prepare clear pre\-sales documentation.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-oriented skills, including solution selling support, understanding of sales cycles, and collaboration with sales teams.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field; experience in enterprise software, BPM, or DMS is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Jaipur, manage multiple client engagements, and use tools for process modeling, documentation, and presentations.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset, attention to detail, and comfort working with regulated sectors like NBFC, Manufacturing, Healthcare, or Government are beneficial.

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an EPM \- ARCS \- Associate \- Consult, you will specialize in providing consulting services for enterprise performance management solutions using Oracle technologies. You will collaborate with clients to assess their performance management needs, design and implement Oracle\-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will be part of a dynamic team that helps clients optimize operational efficiency. This opportunity allows you to engage in research, participate in project tasks, and develop basic skills and knowledge, all while responding effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.

* Collaborating with clients to assess and address their enterprise performance management needs using Oracle technologies

* Utilizing skills in financial planning and analysis for client projects

* Applying strategic data analysis to inform decision\-making processes
* Excelling in communication and teamwork within diverse environments

title: Business Analyst - GTM (Go-To-Market)
description:
**Role Name: Business Analyst \- GTM (Go\-To\-Market)**
**At Kapture CX, we are looking for a Business Analyst in our GTM team**
**Who are we?**
 Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI\-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight\-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.
   

  

 Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca\-Cola, BigBasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank, and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry\-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
   

  

 Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR, as well as international offices across the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 At Kapture CX, our GTM team drives strategic expansion, revenue execution, and operational efficiency across growth and customer\-facing functions. As a Business Analyst \- GTM, you will work on high\-impact initiatives, taking ownership of projects end\-to\-end while driving program management and business analytics to optimize Go\-To\-Market execution.
   

  

 Rather than managing routine operational tickets, you will lead end\-to\-end GTM projects, streamline cross\-functional programs, leverage data to deliver actionable insights, and build scalable workflows that help leadership make smarter decisions.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
**Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**
* End\-to\-End Project \& Program Management: Own and execute strategic GTM projects from conception to completion, ensuring alignment across cross\-functional teams, clear milestone tracking, and timely delivery.
* Business Analytics \& Insights: Conduct deep\-dive business analytics across GTM data, customer journeys, and operational metrics to deliver dashboards, reports, and insights that support leadership decision\-making.
* Workflow \& Process Optimization: Analyze GTM and customer\-facing operational workflows to identify bottlenecks, streamline cross\-departmental handoffs, and design scalable, data\-driven solutions.
* AI \& Automation Integration: Build and implement AI\-powered tools such as knowledge assistants, chatbots, and workflow copilots to improve team productivity.
* Cross\-Functional Ownership: Lead strategic cross\-functional programs (e.g., Customer360, Self\-Service Portals, Enablement) by owning analysis, documentation, and execution workstreams.


**This is a Bangalore\-based role.** 
 We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person collaboration drives innovation and faster execution.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
 You seamlessly lead GTM projects end\-to\-end, ensuring cross\-functional initiatives move efficiently through structured program management. Leadership relies heavily on the business analytics, dashboards, and reporting models you build to make informed decisions, while your process improvements and automations noticeably accelerate GTM operations.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Manager, or Project Manager with a solid SaaS background (B2B SaaS preferred).
* Project \& Program Management: Hands\-on experience managing projects end\-to\-end using tools like JIRA, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or Monday.com.
* Business Analytics \& Data Tools: Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for handling large datasets, reporting, and dashboard creation; experience with BI platforms is a plus.
* AI \& Automation Native: Comfortable working with AI tools (e.g., OpenAI, Claude) and understanding how to apply them to optimize business workflows.


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* End\-to\-end program and project management with structured execution and milestone tracking.
* Strong business analytics capabilities and structured problem\-solving to break down complex datasets into actionable solutions.
* Proactive identification of automation opportunities across GTM workflows.
* Clear executive communication and seamless collaboration across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* Have strong experience with SaaS CRM, Customer Success, or revenue platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Have built internal tools, AI assistants, or low\-code/no\-code automation workflows for GTM teams.
* Have previously driven cross\-functional enablement or GTM operations in a scaling SaaS environment.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here's What You Will Gain From This Role**
* Direct ownership of core Go\-To\-Market programs, analytics, and end\-to\-end execution.
* Mentorship from senior leaders with a clear trajectory toward Program Management and Operations leadership.
* Hands\-on exposure at the intersection of SaaS, Business Analytics, and AI technology.
* Rapid career acceleration within a fast\-growing global SaaS organization with competitive compensation.


**Does this sound like you?**
 Click the Apply button to let us know!
